words.ex: The monotonous lecture was so soporific that I couldn't keep my eyes open.
words.ex_cn: 那个单调乏味的讲座让我昏昏欲睡，眼睛都睁不开了。
words.en: A soporific substance or activity makes you feel sleepy.

words.tr: adj. 轻率的；肤浅的；易做到的
words.ex: He gave a facile answer to the hard question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个难题给出了一个简单的答案。
words.en: If you describe someone's arguments or suggestions as facile, you are criticizing them because their ideas are too simple and indicate a lack of careful, intelligent thinking.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FALL/FALS

words.ex: The news was false.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻是虚假的。
words.en: If something is false, it is incorrect, untrue, or mistaken.

words.ex: His argument is fallacious because it ignores the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点是错误的，因为它忽略了事实。
words.en: If an idea, argument, or reason is fallacious, it is wrong because it is based on a fallacy.

words.ex: He tried to falsify the report.
words.ex_cn: 他试图篡改报告。
words.en: To falsify means to change something in order to deceive people, or to make a false statement.

words.ex: Everyone is fallible, even teachers.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都会犯错，即使是老师。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is fallible, you mean that they are not perfect and are likely to make mistakes or to fail in what they are doing.

words.ex: The pope is considered infallible in matters of faith by some Catholics.
words.ex_cn: 一些天主教徒认为教皇在信仰问题上是一贯正确的。
words.en: If a person or thing is infallible, they are never wrong or never fail.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FED

words.tr: adj. 联邦的；联邦制的；联邦政府的；
words.ex: The federal government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A federal system of government is one in which there is a central government and separate governments for each of the states or regions.

words.ex: The countries formed a federation to share resources.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个联盟来共享资源。
words.en: A federation is a group of states or organizations that have joined together to form a single entity with a central government or authority.

words.ex: The country is a federacy with many self-governing regions.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是一个联邦制国家，拥有许多自治地区。
words.en: A federacy is a political entity characterized by a union of partially self-governing states or regions under a central (federal) government.

words.ex: The country is a federative republic.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是一个联邦制共和国。
words.en: Relating to or involving a federation, especially a federal government or system.

words.ex: The two countries formed a confederate alliance to defend their borders.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成了同盟联盟以保卫它们的边界。
words.en: A confederate is someone who works with others to achieve a common goal, often in a political or military context. It can also refer to a member of a confederation, which is a union of states or groups united for a common purpose.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FER

words.ex: The forest has many coniferous trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有很多针叶树。
words.en: Coniferous refers to trees that produce cones and have needle-shaped leaves, typically evergreen.

words.ex: The village gets water from a deep aquifer.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的水源来自一个深层地下蓄水层。
words.en: An aquifer is a body of permeable rock which can contain or transmit groundwater.

words.tr: adj. 传播疾病的；有害的，毒害的；邪恶的
words.ex: The pestiferous smell made everyone leave the room.
words.ex_cn: 那股令人讨厌的气味让所有人都离开了房间。
words.en: Carrying or tending to spread pestilence; morally or socially harmful; annoying.

words.tr: adj. 大声喊叫的；喧嚷的
words.ex: The vociferous crowd shouted for change.
words.ex_cn: 喧闹的人群大声要求变革。
words.en: If you describe someone as vociferous, you mean that they speak with great energy and determination, because they want their views to be heard.

words.tr: adj.产孢子的; 有芽孢的
words.ex: The sponge is sporiferous.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵是产孢的。
words.en: Producing or bearing spores.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FID

words.ex: She confides in her best friend.
words.ex_cn: 她向最好的朋友倾诉。
words.en: If you confide in someone, you tell them a secret.

words.ex: His fidelity to his friend never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: Fidelity is loyalty to a person, organization, or set of beliefs.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.tr: adj. 不忠的；背信弃义的
words.ex: The perfidious traitor betrayed his comrades.
words.ex_cn: 那个背信弃义的叛徒背叛了他的同伙。
words.en: If you describe someone as perfidious, you mean that they have betrayed someone or cannot be trusted.

words.ex: She was his confidante during the difficult times.
words.ex_cn: 在困难时期，她是他的知心女友。
words.en: A confidante is a woman to whom secrets are confided or with whom private matters and problems are discussed.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FIN

words.ex: The book has a finite number of pages.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的页数是有限的。
words.en: Something that is finite has a definite fixed size or extent.

words.ex: The finale of the concert was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的终曲非常激动人心。
words.en: The finale is the last part of a piece of music, a performance, or a public event, especially when this is particularly dramatic or exciting.

words.tr: adj. 决定性的；权威性的；确定的；
words.ex: The test results were definitive.
words.ex_cn: 这些检测结果是决定性的。
words.en: A definitive book, performance, or report is considered to be the best of its kind that has ever been done or that will ever be done.

words.tr: phrase. 世纪末；尤指19世纪末的欧洲文化氛围
words.ex: The art movement was popular at the fin de sicle in Europe.
words.ex_cn: 这一艺术运动在19世纪末的欧洲很流行。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of the end of a century, especially the 19th century, with regard to its cultural, artistic, and social styles or attitudes.

words.tr: phrase. 无限地；无止境地；不断地重复
words.ex: The argument could go on ad infinitum.
words.ex_cn: 这个争论可以无休止地进行下去。
words.en: If something happens ad infinitum, it happens repeatedly and never ends.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FLECT/FLEX

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr: n. 反射动作；本能反应；反射作用；
words.ex: The knee jerk is a simple reflex.
words.ex_cn: 膝跳是一种简单的反射动作。
words.en: An automatic and often inborn response to a stimulus that typically involves a nerve impulse passing inward from a receptor to the spinal cord and then outward to an effector (as a muscle or gland) without reaching the level of consciousness.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: The mirror deflects the light to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 镜子把光线反射到墙上。
words.en: If you deflect something such as criticism or attention, you act in a way that prevents it from being directed towards you or affecting you.

words.tr: n. 音调符号; adj. 弯曲的；有声调符号的; v. 标有抑扬音符；弯曲
words.ex: The circumflex accent is used in French to indicate a rising and then falling pitch.
words.ex_cn: 法语中使用抑扬音符来表示先升后降的音调。
words.en: A circumflex is a mark (^) placed over a vowel in some languages to indicate a particular pronunciation, length, or stress, or over a consonant in some scripts to indicate a particular sound.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FLU/FLUCT/FLUX

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.ex: The confluence of the two rivers created a fertile valley.
words.ex_cn: 两条河流的汇流形成了一个肥沃的山谷。
words.en: The confluence of two or more things is the junction or merging of them, often forming something greater or more complex.

words.tr:
n. 流量；流动；变动
v. 熔化；熔解；流出
words.ex: The flux of water through the pipe is very high.
words.ex_cn: 管道中水的流量非常高。
words.en: Flux is a state of constant change or a flow of liquid.

words.ex: The reflux of the tide created a strong current.
words.ex_cn: 退潮产生了强劲的水流。
words.en: The term 'reflux' refers to the backward flow of a liquid or gas, often used in medical contexts to describe the flow of stomach acid back into the esophagus.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FORT

words.tr: v. 设防御工事；加强；增加营养物
words.ex: The soldiers fortify the hill with walls and trenches.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在山上用墙壁和战壕设防御工事。
words.en: To strengthen a place with defensive works so as to protect it against attack; to strengthen or invigorate someone mentally or physically.

words.tr:
n. 专长；特长
adv. 用强音
words.ex: His forte is playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他的强项是弹钢琴。
words.en: A thing at which someone excels.

words.ex: He showed great fortitude during the hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他在艰难时期展现了极大的毅力。
words.en: Fortitude is the mental and emotional strength that enables a person to face difficulty, danger, or pain without fear.

words.ex: It was fortuitous that he found his keys just before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他在出发前刚好找到钥匙，真是幸运。
words.en: If you describe something as fortuitous, you mean that it happens by chance rather than by anyone's planning or intention.

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fortress from enemy attacks.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫堡垒，抵御敌人的进攻。
words.en: A fortress is a large building or complex of buildings used as a military stronghold.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FRAC/FRAG/FRING

words.tr: adj. 少量的；微小的；分数的
words.ex: He gave a fractional amount of money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他捐了一点钱给慈善机构。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a fraction or fractions; very small or slight.

words.ex: Light is refracted when it passes through a prism.
words.ex_cn: 当光线通过棱镜时会发生折射。
words.en: To cause (light or sound) to change direction when it enters at an angle a medium of different density.

words.ex: He infringes the rules by arriving late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而违反了规则。
words.en: To infringe means to violate or break a law, agreement, or right.

words.tr: adj. 易怒的；难驾驭的；脾气不好的
words.ex: The fractious child refused to eat his vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个脾气暴躁的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you describe someone as fractious, you mean they are easily upset or annoyed, and often complain.

words.ex: The diary entries were fragmentary and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这些日记条目是不完整的，难以理解。
words.en: Consisting of small parts that are disconnected or incomplete.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FRAT

words.ex: He joined a fraternity at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学加入了兄弟会。
words.en: Fraternity refers to a group of people sharing a common profession or interests, or a feeling of friendship and mutual support within a group.

words.tr: n. 协会，团体；兄弟般的关系
words.ex: The confraternity was established to promote mutual support among its members.
words.ex_cn: 该协会成立的目的是促进成员之间的相互支持。
words.en: A confraternity is a brotherhood or a society, especially a religious one.

words.ex: The twin boys are fraternal twins.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩是异卵双胞胎。
words.en: Fraternal is used to describe feelings or actions that are like those of a brother towards his brothers or sisters.

words.tr: v. 亲如兄弟；友善交往；和敌兵亲善
words.ex: They quickly began to fraternize with the locals.
words.ex_cn: 他们很快就开始与当地人友好交往。
words.en: If one group of people fraternize with another, they meet or spend time together in a friendly way, especially when they are not supposed to.

words.tr: n. 杀害兄弟者；杀兄弟的行为
words.ex: The act of fratricide is considered one of the most heinous crimes.
words.ex_cn: 杀兄弟的行为被认为是最恶劣的罪行之一。
words.en: Fratricide is the act of killing one's brother or sister, or in a military context, the act of killing a fellow soldier.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes FUNC

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.tr:
adj. 已故的；不复存在的
n. 死者
words.ex: The defunct company no longer exists.
words.ex_cn: 这家已故的公司不再存在。
words.en: No longer existing or functioning; dead or inactive.

words.ex: He gave a perfunctory nod and left.
words.ex_cn: 他敷衍地点了点头，然后离开了。
words.en: If you describe something that is done as perfunctory, you mean that it is done as a duty or a formality, without much care or interest.

words.ex: The functionary's job is to ensure that the procedures are followed correctly.
words.ex_cn: 这位公职人员的工作是确保程序正确执行。
words.en: A functionary is a person who has to perform official functions or duties; an official.

words.ex: The car had a malfunction in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的发动机出现了故障。
words.en: If a machine or device malfunctions, it fails to work properly.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GAM

words.tr: adj. 一夫多妻的；一妻多夫的
words.ex: He is polygamous and has three wives.
words.ex_cn: 他是多妻制的，有三个妻子。
words.en: Polygamous means relating to or characterized by the practice of having more than one spouse at the same time.

words.tr: n. 同部族婚姻；同组结婚；同族结婚；[植] 同系配合，[生物] 同系交配
words.ex: Endogamy is often practiced in small, isolated communities.
words.ex_cn: 同部族婚姻在小而孤立的社区中经常被实践。
words.en: Endogamy is the practice of marrying within a specific social group, caste, or ethnic group, rejecting those from others as unsuitable for marriage or other close personal relationships.

words.tr: n. 异族结婚；[遗] 异系交配
words.ex: Exogamy is a common practice in many cultures.
words.ex_cn: 异族结婚在许多文化中是一种常见的做法。
words.en: The custom of marrying outside a community, clan, or tribe.

words.tr: adj. 性的；受胎的；受精的
words.ex: Gamic reproduction involves the fusion of male and female gametes.
words.ex_cn: 有性生殖涉及雄性和雌性配子的融合。
words.en: Relating to or involving sexual reproduction.

words.ex: They are monogamous and have been married for 20 years.
words.ex_cn: 他们是专一的，已经结婚20年了。
words.en: Being monogamous means having only one sexual partner at a time.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GEN

words.ex: Poverty can engender crime.
words.ex_cn: 贫困会引起犯罪。
words.en: To cause a feeling, situation, or condition to exist.

words.ex: The genesis of the story is a simple dream.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的起源是一个简单的梦。
words.en: The origin or mode of formation of something.

words.ex: He is learning genetics in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学习遗传学。
words.en: Genetics is the study of how characteristics are passed from one generation to another through genes.

words.ex: The gentry owned most of the land in the old village.
words.ex_cn: 绅士阶层拥有这个古老村庄的大部分土地。
words.en: The gentry are people of high social class, especially in the past.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GEO

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: The ancient people believed the earth was geocentric.
words.ex_cn: 古代人认为地球是宇宙的中心。
words.en: Having or representing the earth as the center, as in former astronomical systems.

words.ex: The town uses geothermal energy to heat homes.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇利用地热能为房屋供暖。
words.en: Geothermal refers to the heat that comes from the sub-surface of the earth. It is contained in the rocks and fluids beneath the earth's crust and can be found as far down as to the earth's hot molten rock, magma.

words.ex: He studies geophysics to understand earthquakes.
words.ex_cn: 他学习地球物理学以了解地震。
words.en: Geophysics is the branch of science concerned with the physical processes and properties of the Earth and its surrounding space environment, and the use of quantitative methods for their analysis.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GLOSS/GLOT

words.ex: The glossa of the bee is used to collect nectar.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂的舌状器官用于采集花蜜。
words.en: A glossa is a tongue or tongue-like organ, especially in insects.

words.tr:
adj. 多种语言的；通晓数种语言的
n. 通晓数种语言的人
words.ex: He is a polyglot who speaks five languages.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位会说五种语言的多语者。
words.en: A polyglot is a person who knows and is able to use several languages.

words.tr: n. 语意不清；言语不清
words.ex: Glossolalia is often observed in religious contexts, particularly in Pentecostal churches.
words.ex_cn: 语意不清在宗教场合，特别是在五旬节教会中经常被观察到。
words.en: Glossolalia is the phenomenon of speaking in an unknown language, especially in religious worship.

words.ex: He checked the glossary for the meaning of new words.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅了术语表以了解新词的含义。
words.en: A glossary is a list of terms in a particular domain of knowledge with the definitions for those terms.

words.ex: The glottis is the opening between the vocal cords.
words.ex_cn: 声门是声带之间的开口。
words.en: The glottis is the part of the larynx consisting of the vocal cords and the slit-like opening between them. It is involved in the production of sound through the vibration of the vocal cords.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GRAD/GRESS

words.tr:
v. 倒退；退步；退化
n. 倒退；退步；退化
words.ex: The patient regressed to a childlike state after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后，病人退回到了孩童般的状态。
words.en: If you regress, you return to a previous and less advanced stage of development.

words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.ex: The only egress from the building was blocked by debris.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物的唯一出口被碎片堵住了。
words.en: Egress refers to the act of going out or exiting from a place.

words.ex: The security guard checked the ID of everyone attempting ingress.
words.ex_cn: 保安检查了每一个试图进入的人的身份证。
words.en: Ingress refers to the act of entering or the means by which one enters.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GRAPH/GRAM

words.ex: He studies graphology to understand people's personalities.
words.ex_cn: 他研究笔迹学以了解人们的个性。
words.en: Graphology is the study of handwriting, especially as a means of analyzing a person's character or personality.

words.ex: He read a biographical book about Einstein.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于爱因斯坦的传记书籍。
words.en: Relating to the events of a person's life as written by someone else.

words.ex: He plays music on an old gramophone.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台老式留声机播放音乐。
words.en: A gramophone is an old type of record player.

words.ex: He wrote a short epigram about love.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一首关于爱情的短小警句。
words.en: A short poem or sentence that expresses something such as a feeling or idea in a short and clever or funny way.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GRAT

words.ex: He gratifies his parents by getting good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他通过取得好成绩来让父母感到欣慰。
words.en: If you are gratified by something, it gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

words.ex: He showed gratitude for the help.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对帮助的感激。
words.en: Gratitude is the feeling of being thankful and appreciative.

words.tr: adj. 无故的；无必要的；无偿的；免费的
words.ex: He made a gratuitous comment about her clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的衣服做了毫无必要的评论。
words.en: If you describe something as gratuitous, you mean that it is unnecessary, and often harmful or upsetting.

words.ex: The company made an exgratia payment to the victims of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 公司向事故的受害者进行了出于恩惠的赔偿。
words.en: An exgratia payment is one that is given as a favor or gift, rather than because of any legal requirement.

words.tr: phrase. 不受欢迎的人（尤指被某国政府宣布为不受欢迎而要求离境的外交官）
words.ex: The diplomat was declared a persona non grata and expelled from the country.
words.ex_cn: 这名外交官被宣布为不受欢迎的人并被驱逐出境。
words.en: A person who is not welcome in a particular place or among a particular group, especially because of something they have done.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GRAV/GRIEV

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.tr: n. （拉）庄严；庄重；庄严的举止
words.ex: She carried herself with the gravitas of a seasoned diplomat.
words.ex_cn: 她带着老练外交官的庄严举止。
words.en: If you say that someone has gravitas, you mean that you respect them because they seem serious and intelligent.

words.tr: adj. 痛苦的；严重的；剧烈的
words.ex: The injury caused him grievous pain.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤给他带来了巨大的痛苦。
words.en: If you describe something such as a loss or injury as grievous, you mean that it is extremely serious or worrying in its effects.

words.tr:
adj. 愤愤不平的；委屈的；受害的
v. 令委屈；令苦恼；侵害；“aggrieve”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She felt aggrieved by the unfair treatment she received.
words.ex_cn: 她因受到不公平的对待而感到愤愤不平。
words.en: If you feel aggrieved, you feel upset and angry because you think that you have been treated unfairly.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GREG

words.tr:
n. 总计；集合体
adj. 合计的；总的
v. （使）聚集；聚合；总计为
words.ex: The aggregate of all sales this month is $50,000.
words.ex_cn: 本月所有销售额的总计是5万美元。
words.en: An aggregate is a number of things or people that are considered as a group or a whole.

words.tr: n. 人群；集合在一起的群众；（教堂中的）会众
words.ex: A large congregation gathered in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人聚集在广场上参加节日。
words.en: A congregation is a group of people who are gathered together in a church or synagogue for a religious service.

words.ex: Dolphins are gregarious animals that swim in groups.
words.ex_cn: 海豚是群居动物，成群游泳。
words.en: Someone who is gregarious enjoys being with other people.

words.tr: n. 簇虫; adj. 簇虫亚纲的
words.ex: The study focused on the life cycle of gregarine parasites.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究专注于簇虫寄生虫的生命周期。
words.en: A gregarine is a type of parasitic protozoan that lives in the intestines of invertebrates.

words.ex: The school used to segregate students by race.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过去按种族隔离学生。
words.en: To segregate means to separate one group of people, animals, or things from another, especially because they are of different types or belong to different categories.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes GYN

words.ex: He was known as a misogynist who often made derogatory comments about women.
words.ex_cn: 他以厌恶女人著称，经常对女性发表贬低性言论。
words.en: A misogynist is a man who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.

words.ex: He became a doctor in gynecology.
words.ex_cn: 他成为一名妇科医生。
words.en: The branch of physiology and medicine which deals with the functions and diseases specific to women and girls, especially those affecting the reproductive system.

words.tr: n. 妇女政治；女人当政
words.ex: The concept of gynarchy challenges traditional power structures.
words.ex_cn: 妇女政治的概念挑战了传统的权力结构。
words.en: Gynarchy is a form of society or government in which women hold the power and predominate in roles of political leadership, moral authority, social privilege and control of property.

words.ex: His gynophobia made it difficult for him to interact with women in a normal way.
words.ex_cn: 他的恐女症使他难以与女性正常交往。
words.en: Gynophobia is an irrational fear or aversion towards women.

words.tr: adj. 有女性特征的；妇女的
words.ex: Her gynecoid figure was emphasized by the flowing dress.
words.ex_cn: 她那具有女性特征的身材在飘逸的连衣裙下更加突出。
words.en: Resembling or characteristic of a woman.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes HELIO

words.ex: The heliocentric model shows planets orbiting the sun.
words.ex_cn: 日心说模型显示行星围绕太阳运行。
words.en: Having or representing the sun as the center, as in the accepted astronomical model of the solar system.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians practiced heliolatry as a central part of their religion.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人将太阳崇拜作为他们宗教的核心部分。
words.en: The worship of the sun as a deity.

words.ex: The plant's heliotaxis allows it to follow the sun throughout the day.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物的趋日光性使它能全天跟随太阳。
words.en: The movement of an organism in response to the direction of sunlight.

words.ex: The garden was filled with the sweet scent of heliotrope.
words.ex_cn: 花园里弥漫着天芥菜属植物的甜香。
words.en: A plant of the genus Heliotropium, especially Heliotropium arborescens, which has fragrant purple flowers and is cultivated for its ornamental value.

words.ex: Heliotherapy is often used to treat certain skin conditions.
words.ex_cn: 日光浴治疗法常用于治疗某些皮肤疾病。
words.en: A treatment that involves exposure to sunlight or specific wavelengths of light from an artificial source for the purpose of improving health.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes HEMO

words.tr:
n. 体内大出血；严重流失
v. 体内大出血；（使）严重流失
words.ex: The patient suffered a severe hemorrhage after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 病人在事故后发生了严重的出血。
words.en: A hemorrhage is a severe loss of blood from a burst blood vessel, either inside or outside the body.

words.ex: The doctor checked his hemoglobin level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血红素水平。
words.en: Hemoglobin is the protein molecule in red blood cells that carries oxygen from the lungs to the body's tissues and returns carbon dioxide from the tissues back to the lungs.

words.ex: Hemophilia is a genetic disorder that impairs the body's ability to make blood clots.
words.ex_cn: 血友病是一种遗传性疾病，会损害身体形成血块的能力。
words.en: A hereditary disorder where the blood does not clot properly, leading to excessive bleeding.

words.ex: The patient experienced severe hemoptysis and was immediately hospitalized.
words.ex_cn: 病人出现严重咯血，立即被送入医院。
words.en: Hemoptysis is the coughing up of blood or blood-stained sputum from the bronchi, larynx, trachea, or lungs.

words.ex: She suffers from hemophobia and faints at the sight of blood.
words.ex_cn: 她患有血液恐怖症，一看到血就会晕倒。
words.en: Hemophobia is an extreme and irrational fear of blood, which can cause significant anxiety and avoidance behaviors.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes HERB

words.ex: She drinks herbal tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝草药茶。
words.en: Relating to or made from herbs, especially those used in medicine and cooking.

words.ex: The farmer sprayed herbicide on the weeds.
words.ex_cn: 农民在杂草上喷了除草剂。
words.en: A herbicide is a substance that is used to kill plants, especially weeds.

words.tr: adj. 草本植物的；叶状的
words.ex: The garden was filled with herbaceous plants.
words.ex_cn: 花园里种满了草本植物。
words.en: Herbaceous plants are plants that have non-woody stems. Their above-ground growth largely or totally dies back in winter in the temperate zone, but they may have underground plant parts (roots, bulbs, etc.) that survive.

words.ex: The deer is herbivorous.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿是食草的。
words.en: Herbivorous animals are those that feed on plants.

words.ex: Herbalism has been practiced for centuries as a form of alternative medicine.
words.ex_cn: 草药医术作为替代医学的一种形式，已被实践了几个世纪。
words.en: Herbalism is the study or practice of the medicinal and therapeutic use of plants, especially as a form of alternative medicine.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes HETERO-

words.tr: adj. 异性的；异性恋的; n. 异性恋的人
words.ex: They are a heterosexual couple.
words.ex_cn: 他们是一对异性伴侣。
words.en: A heterosexual person is sexually attracted to people of the opposite sex.

words.ex: His heterodox ideas shocked the traditional scholars.
words.ex_cn: 他的非正统观点让传统学者感到震惊。
words.en: Heterodox ideas, opinions, or practices are different from the accepted or official ones.

words.tr: adj. 异种的；异质的；由不同成份形成的
words.ex: The class is heterogeneous, with students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级是多元的，有来自许多国家的学生。
words.en: A heterogeneous group consists of many different types of things or people.

words.tr: v. 使（交变无线电信号）混合以产生外差效果; adj. （无线电传播中）外差的，外差法的
words.ex: The radio uses a heterodyne circuit to pick up signals.
words.ex_cn: 这台收音机使用差频电路来接收信号。
words.en: Pertaining to the production of a new frequency by the combination of two different frequencies, especially in radio technology.

words.tr: adj. 包含不同颜色的；异色的
words.ex: The artist used a heterochromatic palette to create a vibrant painting.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家使用包含不同颜色的调色板创作了一幅充满活力的画作。
words.en: Having different colors; exhibiting heterochromia.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes HOMO-

words.tr: adj. 类似的；同源的；一致的；相应的
words.ex: The two animals have homologous limbs.
words.ex_cn: 这两种动物有类似的四肢。
words.en: Having the same relation, relative position, or structure, in particular.

words.tr: n. 同形（同音）异义词；同名异物
words.ex: The words 'bear' and 'bare' are homonyms.
words.ex_cn: “bear”和“bare”这两个词是同音异义词。
words.en: A homonym is a word that is pronounced the same as another word but differs in meaning. The words may be spelled the same, such as 'rose' (flower) and 'rose' (past tense of rise), or differently, such as 'carat', 'caret', and 'carrot'.

words.ex: The mixture is homogeneous and looks the same throughout.
words.ex_cn: 这种混合物是均一的，看起来处处都一样。
words.en: Something that is homogeneous is uniform in nature or character throughout.

words.ex: The circles are homocentric with the same center point.
words.ex_cn: 这些圆是同心的，具有相同的中心点。
words.en: Having the same center or origin.

words.ex: The machine will homogenize the milk.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器会将牛奶均质化。
words.en: To homogenize something means to make it the same throughout, or to make it uniform.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes HOM/HOMO/HUMAN

words.tr: adj. 人道的；仁慈的；人文的
words.ex: The shelter treats animals in a humane way.
words.ex_cn: 这个收容所以人道的方式对待动物。
words.en: If you describe something as humane, you mean that it is good and kind, especially because it decreases suffering.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes JAC/JACT/JECT

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: The ball followed a smooth trajectory.
words.ex_cn: 球沿着一条平滑的轨迹飞行。
words.en: The path followed by a projectile flying or an object moving under the action of given forces.

words.ex: He interjected during the meeting to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中插话问了一个问题。
words.en: To say something that interrupts someone who is speaking.

words.tr: v. 射精；射出；突然说出
words.ex: He cannot ejaculate due to medicine.
words.ex_cn: 由于药物，他无法射精。
words.en: To ejaculate means to say something suddenly and briefly, or to emit semen from the penis during orgasm.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes JUR/JUS/JUD

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有见识的；判断正确的
words.ex: He made a judicious choice about which book to buy.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个明智的买书决定。
words.en: If you describe an action or decision as judicious, you approve of it because you think that it shows good judgment and sense.

words.ex: He will perjure himself in court.
words.ex_cn: 他将在法庭上作伪证。
words.en: If someone perjures themselves in a court of law, they lie, even though they have promised to tell the truth.

words.tr: n. 管辖权；司法权；裁判权；
words.ex: The court has jurisdiction over this case.
words.ex_cn: 法院对这个案件有管辖权。
words.en: The official power to make legal decisions and judgments.

words.ex: He loves studying jurisprudence to understand laws better.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢学习法学以更好地理解法律。
words.en: Jurisprudence is the study of law and the principles on which law is based.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LECT/LEG/LIG

words.ex: The handwriting is legible and easy to read.
words.ex_cn: 字迹清晰，容易辨认。
words.en: If writing or print is legible, it is clear enough to read.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.tr: n. 挑选者；选拔者；选择器
words.ex: The selector can filter items based on specific criteria.
words.ex_cn: 选择器可以根据特定标准筛选项目。
words.en: A selector is someone who chooses or selects, especially someone whose job is to choose people or things for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The election will be held next month.
words.ex_cn: 选举将在下个月举行。
words.en: An election is a process in which people vote to choose a person or group of people to hold an official position.

words.ex: He has a predilection for sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 他偏爱甜食。
words.en: If you have a predilection for something, you have a strong liking for it.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LEG

words.ex: His legacy includes many charity schools.
words.ex_cn: 他的遗产包括许多慈善学校。
words.en: Something handed down from an ancestor or a predecessor or from the past.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.tr: n. 法律术语，法律措辞
words.ex: The contract was filled with legalese that was difficult to understand.
words.ex_cn: 合同中充满了难以理解的法律术语。
words.en: The specialized language of legal documents and proceedings, often characterized by its complexity and precision.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；法律认可的；合理的；
words.ex: This contract is legitimate and signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同是合法的，并由双方签署。
words.en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LEV

words.ex: His joke brought some levity to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他的笑话为会议带来了一些轻松气氛。
words.en: Levity refers to a lack of seriousness, especially at an inappropriate time, often characterized by frivolity or lightness of manner.

words.tr: vt. 使轻轻浮起；使飘浮空中; vi. 轻轻浮起；飘浮空中
words.ex: The magician claimed he could levitate objects with his mind.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师声称他可以用意念使物体飘浮。
words.en: To rise or cause to rise into the air and float in apparent defiance of gravity.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.tr:
n. 杠杆；杠杆作用；影响力
v. 举债经营；充分利用
words.ex: The mechanic used a lever to lift the car.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用杠杆来抬起汽车。
words.en: Leverage refers to the use of a lever or the mechanical advantage gained by using a lever. In finance, it refers to the use of borrowed capital to increase the potential return of an investment.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LEX

words.ex: He looked up the word in his lexicon.
words.ex_cn: 他在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person, language, or branch of knowledge.

words.ex: He works in lexicography at a dictionary company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家词典公司从事词典编纂工作。
words.en: Lexicography is the activity or profession of writing dictionaries.

words.ex: The lexis of the poem is rich and varied.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的词汇丰富多样。
words.en: The total stock of words in a language.

words.ex: He uses simple lexical items in his writing.
words.ex_cn: 他在写作中使用简单的词汇项。
words.en: Relating to the words or vocabulary of a language.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LIBER

words.ex: He uses simple lexical items in his writing.
words.ex_cn: 他在写作中使用简单的词汇项。
words.en: Relating to the words or vocabulary of a language.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LIBRAR/LIBR

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.tr: n. 图书馆事业；图书馆管理员职位；图书馆管理业务
words.ex: He wants to become a librarian and study librarianship.
words.ex_cn: 他想成为一名图书管理员并学习图书管理学。
words.en: The profession or duties of a librarian; the study of the principles and practices of library management.

words.tr:
n. （文字）诽谤
v. 发表文字诽谤（某人）
words.ex: He wrote a false story about her, and it was libel.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于她的虚假文章，这是诽谤。
words.en: A libel is a published false statement that is damaging to a person's reputation; a written defamation.

words.tr: n. 剧本；歌词；歌剧脚本
words.ex: He wrote the libretto for a famous opera.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部著名的歌剧写了剧本。
words.en: The text of an opera or other long vocal work.

words.tr: n. 歌词作者；剧本作者
words.ex: The librettist collaborated with the composer to create a memorable opera.
words.ex_cn: 歌词作者与作曲家合作创作了一部令人难忘的歌剧。
words.en: A librettist is a person who writes the text of an opera or other long vocal work.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LITER

words.tr: n. 文人；文人学士；知识界；“literatus”的复数
words.ex: The literati gathered to discuss poetry.
words.ex_cn: 文人聚集在一起讨论诗歌。
words.en: The literati are intellectuals or scholars, especially those involved in literature or the arts.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr: n. 缩略字；用字母代表声音或词
words.ex: The use of literation in text messages has become common.
words.ex_cn: 在短信中使用缩略字已经变得很常见。
words.en: The representation or arrangement of letters.

words.ex: He took his words in a literal sense.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的话按字面意思理解。
words.en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LOC/LOG/LOQU

words.tr: adj. 话多的；健谈的；喋喋不休的
words.ex: He is a loquacious man who talks all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个整天喋喋不休的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as loquacious, you mean that they talk a lot.

words.ex: He uses colloquial words when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时使用口语化的词语。
words.en: Colloquial language is informal language that is used in ordinary conversation rather than in writing or formal speech.

words.ex: He spoke a soliloquy alone on stage.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在舞台上说了一段独白。
words.en: A soliloquy is a speech in a play in which a character speaks their thoughts aloud, often when they are alone on stage.

words.tr: n. 迂回累赘的陈述；遁词
words.ex: He used circumlocution to avoid answering the question.
words.ex_cn: 他用绕圈子的说法来避免回答问题。
words.en: Circumlocution is the use of many words where fewer would do, especially in a deliberate attempt to be vague or evasive.

words.ex: The epilogue showed what happened to the characters after the story ended.
words.ex_cn: 尾声展示了故事结束后角色们的命运。
words.en: An epilogue is a section or speech at the end of a book or play that serves as a comment on or a conclusion to what has happened.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LUC/LUM/LUS

words.ex: The teacher gave a lucid explanation of the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这道数学题做了一个易懂的解释。
words.en: If someone is lucid, they are able to understand things clearly and think clearly, especially when they have been very ill or confused.

words.ex: The glass is translucent, so you can see light through it.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃是半透明的，所以你能看到光透过它。
words.en: If a material or substance is translucent, it is almost transparent, allowing some light to pass through it but not detailed shapes.

words.ex: The professor provided a clear elucidation of the complex theory.
words.ex_cn: 教授对复杂的理论进行了清晰的阐释。
words.en: The act of making something clear or easy to understand, especially by explaining it in more detail.

words.tr: adj. 清澈的；透明的；易懂的
words.ex: The water in the mountain stream was so pellucid that we could see the fish swimming.
words.ex_cn: 山间溪流中的水如此清澈，我们可以看到鱼儿在游动。
words.en: If something is pellucid, it is very clear and easy to understand.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes LUD

words.tr: v. 暗指；（间接）提到；影射
words.ex: He alluded to the problem without naming it.
words.ex_cn: 他暗示了这个问题，但没有点明。
words.en: To allude to something means to mention it in an indirect way.

words.tr: adj. 可笑的；荒谬的；滑稽的
words.ex: It is ludicrous to wear a coat in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天穿外套真是荒谬。
words.en: If you describe something as ludicrous, you are emphasizing that you think it is foolish, unreasonable, or unsuitable.

words.ex: The quiet music was a prelude to the loud concert.
words.ex_cn: 轻柔的音乐是盛大音乐会的前奏。
words.en: A prelude is an introductory piece of music, event, or action that comes before a more important one.

words.tr: n. 间歇；插曲；幕间节目
words.ex: He took an interlude to drink water.
words.ex_cn: 他休息了一下喝水。
words.en: An interlude is a short period of time that comes in the middle of something, or a short piece of music, talk, or entertainment that comes between the main parts of a performance or event.

words.ex: The tricky question eluded even the best students.
words.ex_cn: 这道难题难倒了即使是最优秀的学生。
words.en: If something that you want eludes you, you fail to obtain it. If you elude someone or something, you avoid them or escape from them.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MACRO-

words.ex: The study of the macrocosm can be as fascinating as the study of the microcosm.
words.ex_cn: 对宏观世界的研究可以像对微观世界的研究一样迷人。
words.en: The macrocosm refers to the entire complex structure of something, especially the universe or the world as a whole, considered as a single entity.

words.ex: He is learning macroeconomics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习宏观经济学。
words.en: Macroeconomics is the branch of economics concerned with large-scale or general economic factors, such as interest rates and national productivity.

words.ex: The macroscopic view shows the whole tree.
words.ex_cn: 宏观视角展示了整棵树。
words.en: Large enough to be seen or examined without the use of a microscope.

words.tr: n. [生化] 大量营养素；[生化] 常量营养元素；大量养料
words.ex: Carbohydrates are a main macronutrient.
words.ex_cn: 碳水化合物是一种主要的宏量营养素。
words.en: A macronutrient is a type of food (e.g. fat, protein, carbohydrate) required in large amounts in the diet.

words.tr: n. 大红细胞；巨红血球
words.ex: The presence of macrocytes in the blood can indicate a deficiency in vitamin B12.
words.ex_cn: 血液中出现大红细胞可能表明缺乏维生素B12。
words.en: An abnormally large red blood cell, typically associated with certain types of anemia.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MAGN-

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.tr: n. 巨头；大亨；大资本家
words.ex: The magnate owns many hotels and airlines.
words.ex_cn: 这位大亨拥有许多酒店和航空公司。
words.en: A magnate is a person who is very rich and powerful, especially in a particular industry.

words.ex: The magnitude of this decision will affect everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定的重要性会影响每个人。
words.en: Magnitude refers to the great size or extent of something, or the importance of something.

words.ex: He showed magnanimity by forgiving his enemy.
words.ex_cn: 他宽恕了敌人，展现了宽宏大量。
words.en: Magnanimity is the quality of being kind, generous, and forgiving, especially towards someone who has wronged you.

words.tr: phrase. 以优异成绩（毕业），获得较高荣誉学位
words.ex: She graduated magna cum laude from Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 她以优异的成绩从哈佛大学毕业。
words.en: with great praise, used to denote a level of academic distinction

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MAL-

words.tr:
adj. 有害的；恶意的
v. 中伤；污蔑
words.ex: The virus is malign and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒是有害的，并且传播迅速。
words.en: If you malign someone, you say unpleasant and untrue things about them. If something is malign, it is harmful or evil.

words.tr: n. 身体不适；不快；萎靡不振；痼疾
words.ex: She felt a general malaise after the long flight.
words.ex_cn: 长途飞行后，她感到全身不适。
words.en: A general feeling of discomfort, illness, or unease whose exact cause is difficult to identify.

words.ex: He sent a malicious email to hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他发了一封怀恶意的邮件来伤害他的朋友。
words.en: If you describe someone's words or actions as malicious, you mean that they are intended to harm people or their reputation, or to cause them embarrassment and upset.

words.ex: The police caught the malefactor who stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了偷钱的罪犯。
words.en: A malefactor is someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MAN

words.ex: The police caught the malefactor who stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了偷钱的罪犯。
words.en: A malefactor is someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MAND

words.ex: The police caught the malefactor who stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了偷钱的罪犯。
words.en: A malefactor is someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MANIA

words.ex: The police caught the malefactor who stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了偷钱的罪犯。
words.en: A malefactor is someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MAR/MARI

words.ex: The police caught the malefactor who stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了偷钱的罪犯。
words.en: A malefactor is someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MATER/MATR

words.ex: The police caught the malefactor who stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了偷钱的罪犯。
words.en: A malefactor is someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MEGA-

words.ex: The police caught the malefactor who stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了偷钱的罪犯。
words.en: A malefactor is someone who has committed a crime or done something wrong.

words.ex: Ancient people built a megalith to honor their gods.
words.ex_cn: 古人建造了一座巨石来纪念他们的神。
words.en: A megalith is a large stone that has been used to construct a structure or monument, either alone or together with other stones.

words.ex: The megalopolis is home to millions of people.
words.ex_cn: 这个特大都市是数百万人的家园。
words.en: A very large, densely populated urban complex, typically consisting of several cities merging together.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes META

words.ex: Calling time a thief is a metaphor.
words.ex_cn: 把时间称为小偷是一种隐喻。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

words.ex: The caterpillar's metamorphosis into a butterfly takes weeks.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶的变形需要几周时间。
words.en: Metamorphosis is a process of transformation from an immature form to an adult form in two or more distinct stages.

words.tr: n. [医] 化生，[医] 转化；[医] 组织变形
words.ex: Metaplasia can occur in response to chronic irritation.
words.ex_cn: 化生可以发生在对慢性刺激的反应中。
words.en: Metaplasia is the transformation of one differentiated cell type to another differentiated cell type. It is a reversible change and is considered an adaptation to stress or chronic irritation.

words.ex: The process of metanoia is often seen as a transformative journey.
words.ex_cn: 悔改的过程通常被视为一个转变的旅程。
words.en: A transformative change of heart; especially: a spiritual conversion.

words.ex: He is thinking about metaphysical questions.
words.ex_cn: 他正在思考形而上学的问题。
words.en: Metaphysical means relating to metaphysics, which is the branch of philosophy that deals with the first principles of things, including abstract concepts such as being, knowing, substance, cause, identity, time, and space.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes METER/METR

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.ex: The technician used a micrometer to measure the thickness of the metal sheet.
words.ex_cn: 技术员使用千分尺测量金属板的厚度。
words.en: A micrometer is a device used for measuring very small distances or angles, especially in engineering and manufacturing.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MICRO-

words.ex: The technician used a micrometer to measure the thickness of the metal sheet.
words.ex_cn: 技术员使用千分尺测量金属板的厚度。
words.en: A micrometer is a device used for measuring very small distances or angles, especially in engineering and manufacturing.

words.tr: n. 显微学，显微科学；拘于细节的研讨
words.ex: His micrology often distracts from the main point of the discussion.
words.ex_cn: 他拘于细节的研讨常常使讨论偏离主题。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the use of the microscope; the study of minute objects or details.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MIN-

words.tr: n. 显微学，显微科学；拘于细节的研讨
words.ex: His micrology often distracts from the main point of the discussion.
words.ex_cn: 他拘于细节的研讨常常使讨论偏离主题。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the use of the microscope; the study of minute objects or details.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.ex: He was obsessed with the minutiae of daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他对日常生活的琐事着迷。
words.en: The small, precise, or trivial details of something.

words.ex: The minuscule dot was hard to see with the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 那个极小的点用肉眼很难看到。
words.en: If you describe something as minuscule, you mean that it is very small.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MIS-

words.ex: He misconstrued her smile as anger.
words.ex_cn: 他误解了她的微笑，以为是生气。
words.en: If you misconstrue something that has been said or something that happens, you interpret it wrongly.

words.tr: n. 误称…之名；不当之名
words.ex: Calling a tomato a vegetable is a misnomer.
words.ex_cn: 把番茄称为蔬菜是一种错误的称呼。
words.en: A misnomer is a name that is wrongly or unsuitably applied to someone or something.

words.ex: His misanthropy was evident in his solitary lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他独居的生活方式明显表现出他对人类的厌恶。
words.en: Misanthropy is a general dislike, distrust, or hatred of the human species or a disposition to dislike and/or distrust other people's silent consensus about reality.

words.ex: He was known as a misogynist who often made derogatory comments about women.
words.ex_cn: 他以厌恶女人著称，经常对女性发表贬低性言论。
words.en: A misogynist is a man who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MISS/MIT

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.ex: He sent a remittance to his family last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周给家人汇了一笔款。
words.en: A remittance is a sum of money that you send to someone.

words.ex: He received a missive from the headquarters.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了来自总部的公函。
words.en: A missive is a letter or other written message.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The judge issued a mittimus for the prisoner.
words.ex_cn: 法官对囚犯发出了收押令。
words.en: A mittimus is a warrant issued by a court or magistrate directing a jailer to detain a person or to transfer a prisoner to another facility.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MOB/MOT/MOV

words.ex: The injured man was immobile after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，这名受伤的人无法移动。
words.en: If something is immobile, it is not moving or cannot move.

words.ex: The new policy improves worker mobility.
words.ex_cn: 新政策提高了工人的流动性。
words.en: The ability to move or be moved freely and easily.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.tr: adj. 使感动的；感情的；动感情的
words.ex: The movie used emotive music to make people cry.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影用了富有情感的音乐来让人流泪。
words.en: If you describe something as emotive, you mean that it is concerned with emotions and feelings, and often causes them.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MONO-

words.ex: He believes in monogamy and stays with one partner.
words.ex_cn: 他相信一夫一妻制，并且只与一个伴侣在一起。
words.en: The practice or condition of having a single sexual partner during a period of time.

words.tr: n. 独白；独角戏；长篇大论
words.ex: He gave a monologue on stage.
words.ex_cn: 他在舞台上发表了一段独白。
words.en: A monologue is a long speech by one person, especially in a play or film, or a long speech by one person during a conversation.

words.ex: The formation of the monocline was influenced by tectonic forces.
words.ex_cn: 单斜层的形成受到构造力的影响。
words.en: A monocline is a geological formation in which all strata are inclined in the same direction.

words.tr: adj. 单色的； 单频的（光、辐射等）
words.ex: The painting is monochromatic, using only shades of blue.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是单色的，只使用了不同深浅的蓝色。
words.en: Consisting of one color or wavelength.

words.tr: adj.  独块巨石的；整体的；庞大的；单一的；统一的
words.ex: The ancient temple was built from a monolithic stone.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代神庙是由一块巨石建成的。
words.en: A monolithic structure is extremely large and made of one piece or one type of material.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MON/MONIT

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The teacher admonished the student to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师劝告学生完成作业。
words.en: To admonish someone means to tell them in a serious way that they have done something wrong.

words.ex: The teacher gave him an admonition for being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他迟到而给了他一个警告。
words.en: An admonition is a warning or a piece of advice that is given to someone to correct their behavior or to prevent them from doing something wrong.

words.ex: She had a premonition that something bad was going to happen.
words.ex_cn: 她有一种不祥的预感，觉得会有坏事发生。
words.en: A premonition is a feeling that something, especially something unpleasant, is going to happen.

words.tr: v. 抗议；表示异议；劝诫
words.ex: He remonstrated with his friend for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为朋友迟到而责备了他。
words.en: To remonstrate means to make a forcefully reproachful protest.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MORI/MORT

words.tr: adj. 濒临死亡的；垂死的；
words.ex: The moribund patient stopped breathing.
words.ex_cn: 这位濒临死亡的病人停止了呼吸。
words.en: If you describe something as moribund, you mean that it is in a very bad condition and is not active or successful.

words.ex: Legends say that some heroes are immortal.
words.ex_cn: 传说有些英雄是不死的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as immortal, you mean that they are so famous or popular that they will be remembered for a very long time.

words.tr: n. 屈辱感；窘迫感；坏疽
words.ex: The mortification of his public failure was almost unbearable.
words.ex_cn: 他因公开失败而感到的屈辱几乎难以忍受。
words.en: A feeling of shame, humiliation, or wounded pride.

words.tr: n. 殡仪业者；承办殡葬的人
words.ex: The mortician prepared the body for the funeral.
words.ex_cn: 殡葬业者为葬礼准备了遗体。
words.en: A mortician is a person whose job is to arrange and manage funerals.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MORPH

words.tr: adj. 无定形的；无组织的；
words.ex: The glass is amorphous because it lacks a regular shape.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃是无定形的，因为它没有规则的形状。
words.en: Lacking a clear shape or form; not clearly defined or structured.

words.tr: n. 形态测量学；形态计量术
words.ex: Morphometry is used to analyze the shape and size of biological structures.
words.ex_cn: 形态测量学用于分析生物结构的形状和大小。
words.en: Morphometry refers to the quantitative analysis of form, a concept that encompasses size and shape. It is widely used in biological sciences to study the variations in the physical dimensions and geometry of organisms and their parts.

words.ex: Biology students learn morphology to study plant shapes.
words.ex_cn: 生物学生学习形态学来研究植物的形状。
words.en: Morphology is the study of the form and structure of organisms or their parts.

words.tr: adj. 拟人的；赋予人性的；神人同形同性论的
words.ex: The cartoon characters were anthropomorphic animals.
words.ex_cn: 卡通角色是拟人化的动物。
words.en: Anthropomorphic refers to the attribution of human traits, emotions, or intentions to non-human entities.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MULTI-

words.tr: n. [妇产] 经产妇；非初产妇
words.ex: The multipara was advised to take extra care during her pregnancy.
words.ex_cn: 这位经产妇被建议在怀孕期间要格外小心。
words.en: A woman who has given birth two or more times.

words.ex: He is a multifaceted person who can sing, paint, and code.
words.ex_cn: 他是个多方面的人，会唱歌、绘画和编程。
words.en: Having many facets or aspects.

words.tr: adj. 多种的；各式各样的
words.ex: She has multifarious hobbies, like painting, singing, and gardening.
words.ex_cn: 她有很多不同的爱好，比如绘画、唱歌和园艺。
words.en: If you describe things as multifarious, you mean that they are many and of various types.

words.tr: n. 大数目；多种多样；繁多
words.ex: There is a multiplicity of stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有大量星星。
words.en: A multiplicity of things or people means a large number or great variety of them.

words.ex: A multitude of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 大量的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes MUT

words.tr: adj. 变化的；生物突变的
words.ex: The mutative process in cells can lead to various genetic disorders.
words.ex_cn: 细胞中的变化过程可能导致各种遗传疾病。
words.en: Relating to or resulting from mutation or change.

words.ex: The mutation caused the plant to grow differently.
words.ex_cn: 这种突变使植物的生长方式发生了变化。
words.en: A mutation is a change in the structure of the genes of an organism that results in a variant form which may be transmitted to subsequent generations, caused by the alteration of single base units in DNA, or the deletion, insertion, or rearrangement of larger sections of genes or chromosomes.

words.ex: The magic spell caused the transmutation of the frog into a prince.
words.ex_cn: 魔法咒语让青蛙变成了王子。
words.en: The act or process of changing something completely, especially into something different and better.

words.tr: adj. 不可改变的；永恒不变的
words.ex: The password is immutable and cannot be changed.
words.ex_cn: 密码是不可更改的。
words.en: If you say that something is immutable, you mean that it cannot be changed at all.

words.tr: adj. 可变的；易变的；性情不定的
words.ex: Her mood is as mutable as the weather.
words.ex_cn: 她的情绪就像天气一样多变。
words.en: Capable of or subject to change or alteration.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NAS/NAT

words.ex: His nationality is Canadian.
words.ex_cn: 他的国籍是加拿大人。
words.en: Nationality is the legal relationship between an individual and a state, often used to refer to the country to which a person belongs.

words.tr: n. 出生；出生地；（Nativity）耶稣的诞生
words.ex: The painting depicts the nativity of Christ.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了耶稣的诞生。
words.en: The term 'nativity' refers to the occasion of a person's birth, especially with reference to the circumstances or place of birth. It is also commonly used to refer to the birth of Jesus Christ, celebrated by Christians at Christmas.

words.ex: He visited his natal village for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 他第一次回到了自己的出生村庄。
words.en: Relating to the place or time of one's birth

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: The nascent industry is growing quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个新生的产业正在迅速发展。
words.en: Nascent things or processes are just beginning, and are expected to become stronger or to grow bigger.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NAV

words.ex: He works on a naval ship.
words.ex_cn: 他在一艘军舰上工作。
words.en: Naval means relating to the navy, especially to ships that are used in war.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.tr: n. 古希腊舰队指挥官
words.ex: The navarch commanded the entire fleet during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这位舰队指挥官在战斗中指挥整个舰队。
words.en: In ancient Greece, a navarch was a commander of a fleet or navy.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NEC/NIC/NOC/NOX

words.tr: n. 古希腊舰队指挥官
words.ex: The navarch commanded the entire fleet during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这位舰队指挥官在战斗中指挥整个舰队。
words.en: In ancient Greece, a navarch was a commander of a fleet or navy.

words.ex: The chemical is nocent to the environment.
words.ex_cn: 这种化学物质对环境有害。
words.en: Causing harm or injury; guilty of a crime.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NECRO-

words.tr: n. 古希腊舰队指挥官
words.ex: The navarch commanded the entire fleet during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这位舰队指挥官在战斗中指挥整个舰队。
words.en: In ancient Greece, a navarch was a commander of a fleet or navy.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NEG

words.ex: He tries to negate the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图否认事实。
words.en: If someone negates something, they say that it does not exist or is not true.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: He reneged on his promise to help me.
words.ex_cn: 他背弃了帮助我的承诺。
words.en: If someone reneges on a promise or an agreement, they do not do what they have promised or agreed to do.

words.tr: adj. 疏忽的；粗心的；不在意的
words.ex: He was negligent in doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业时很疏忽。
words.en: If you say that someone is negligent, you mean that they do not take enough care over something that they are responsible for.

words.ex: The error is negligible.
words.ex_cn: 这个误差可以忽略。
words.en: If you describe something as negligible, you mean that it is so small or unimportant that it is not worth considering or worrying about.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NEO-

words.ex: The internet created many new neologisms like 'selfie' and 'blog'.
words.ex_cn: 互联网创造了许多新词，比如'selfie'和'blog'。
words.en: A neologism is a newly coined word or expression that may be in the process of entering common use, but has not yet been accepted into mainstream language.

words.tr: n. 新信徒；新手；初学者
words.ex: The neophyte learned the prayers from the elder.
words.ex_cn: 新信徒向长者学习祷告。
words.en: A neophyte is someone who is new to a particular activity, subject, or religion and is therefore inexperienced.

words.ex: The neonate cried loudly after birth.
words.ex_cn: 新生儿出生后大声哭喊。
words.en: A neonate is a newborn child, especially one less than four weeks old.

words.ex: The study focused on the causes of neoplasia in the population.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究专注于该人群中瘤形成的原因。
words.en: The formation of a neoplasm or tumor; the process of tumor development.

words.ex: People in the Neolithic age used stone tools.
words.ex_cn: 新石器时代的人们使用石器。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the later part of the Stone Age, when ground or polished stone weapons and implements prevailed.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NEUR

words.ex: He works in neurology at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院从事神经学工作。
words.en: The branch of medicine or biology that deals with the anatomy, functions, and organic disorders of nerves and the nervous system.

words.tr: n. 神经症；神经衰弱症
words.ex: He has a neurosis about being late.
words.ex_cn: 他对迟到有一种神经症般的焦虑。
words.en: A neurosis is a mental illness that causes feelings of fear and worry, often leading to unreasonable behavior.

words.ex: The neuroid system is designed to mimic the human brain's neural network.
words.ex_cn: 这种神经元网络系统旨在模仿人脑的神经网络。
words.en: Resembling a nerve or the nervous system.

words.ex: She suffers from chronic neuralgia in her left arm.
words.ex_cn: 她左臂患有慢性神经痛。
words.en: Neuralgia is a sharp, severe pain along the course of a nerve, especially in the head or face.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NEUT/NEUTR

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.tr: v. 使中立；中和；使无效
words.ex: The government tried to neutralize the conflict by talking to both sides.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图通过与双方交谈来使冲突中立化。
words.en: To neutralize something means to stop it from having any effect or to make it ineffective.

words.ex: He kept neutrality during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: The state of not supporting or helping either side in a conflict, disagreement, etc.; impartiality.

words.ex: The neutron has no electric charge.
words.ex_cn: 中子不带电荷。
words.en: A neutron is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of every atom except that of simple hydrogen. It has no electric charge and a mass slightly greater than that of a proton.

words.tr: adj. 中性的；无生殖器的；无性的; v. 阉割（动物）；使无效，使失去作用；瓦解; n. 中性词...
words.ex: The teacher used a neuter pronoun to avoid gender bias.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用中性代词以避免性别偏见。
words.en: Neuter means to remove the reproductive organs of an animal to prevent it from having offspring, or describes something that is neither masculine nor feminine in gender.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NOCT/NOX

words.ex: Owls are nocturnal animals.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰是夜间活动的动物。
words.en: Nocturnal means happening in the night or active at night.

words.tr: n. 昼夜平分日（指春分或秋分）
words.ex: The equinox happens in March and September.
words.ex_cn: 春分和秋分发生在三月和九月。
words.en: Either of the two times in the year when the sun crosses the celestial equator, when day and night are of equal length.

words.tr: adj. 夜间步行的；梦游的
words.ex: He is noctambulant and walks at night.
words.ex_cn: 他是个夜行者，晚上走路。
words.en: Walking or moving about at night; sleepwalking.

words.tr: adj. 夜游的，晚间徘徊的
words.ex: The noctivagant owl walks under the moon.
words.ex_cn: 那只夜间游荡的猫头鹰在月光下行走。
words.en: Wandering or moving about at night.

words.ex: The noctilucous jellyfish glow in the dark sea.
words.ex_cn: 夜光水母在黑暗的海水中发光。
words.en: Shining or glowing in the dark; phosphorescent.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NOM/NOMEN/NYM

words.ex: He accepted a nominal fee for the service.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项服务收取了微不足道的费用。
words.en: If you say that something is nominal, you mean that it is very small in comparison to the real value or importance of something.

words.tr: n. 误称…之名；不当之名
words.ex: Calling a tomato a vegetable is a misnomer.
words.ex_cn: 把番茄称为蔬菜是一种错误的称呼。
words.en: A misnomer is a name that is wrongly or unsuitably applied to someone or something.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NON-

words.tr:
adj. 不知所措的；陷于窘境的
v. 使迷惑；使不知所措；“nonplus”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was nonplussed by the unexpected question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个意外的问题感到不知所措。
words.en: If you are nonplussed, you are so surprised and confused that you do not know what to say or do.

words.tr: adj. 若无其事的；不在乎的；冷淡的
words.ex: He was nonchalant about the test result.
words.ex_cn: 他对考试结果表现得漫不经心。
words.en: If you describe someone as nonchalant, you mean that they appear not to worry or care about things and that they seem very calm.

words.tr: phrase. 不合逻辑的推论；前后不连贯的陈述；与前提无关的结论
words.ex: His answer was a non sequitur.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答毫不相关。
words.en: A conclusion or statement that does not logically follow from the previous argument or statement.

words.tr:
adj. 无可名状的；难以区别的；无特征的；极普通的
n. 无以名状；不属任何类型的人
words.ex: The building was nondescript, with no special features.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑无可名状，没有任何特别的特征。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as nondescript, you mean that their appearance is rather dull, and not at all interesting or attractive.

words.tr: phrase. 〈拉〉 不允许；不合法；被禁止
words.ex: Non licet to enter without permission.
words.ex_cn: 未经允许不得进入。
words.en: Not allowed or not permitted, often used in historical or formal contexts to denote actions that are forbidden.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NOV

words.ex: They will renovate the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新那栋老房子。
words.en: To renovate means to restore something to a good state of repair or to make it as good as new.

words.ex: He is a novice at playing the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是个吉他新手。
words.en: A novice is someone who has just started learning or doing something and does not have much experience.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: He entered the novitiate to learn about religious life.
words.ex_cn: 他进入初修院学习宗教生活。
words.en: The period of being a novice in a religious order, or a person who is in this period.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes NUM

words.tr: n. 古币；钱币学；奖章类的研究
words.ex: He collects old coins and studies numismatics.
words.ex_cn: 他收集旧硬币并研究钱币学。
words.en: Numismatics is the study or collection of currency, including coins, tokens, paper money, and related objects.

words.tr:
n. 数字
adj. 数的；表示数的
words.ex: He wrote the numeral five on the board.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑板上写了数字五。
words.en: A numeral is a symbol or group of symbols that represents a number.

words.ex: He will enumerate the steps clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他将清晰地列出这些步骤。
words.en: To enumerate means to mention things one by one.

words.tr: n. 数字命理学；数字占卜术
words.ex: He believes in numerology and checks his lucky numbers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他相信数字命理学，每天都会查看自己的幸运数字。
words.en: Numerology is the study of the purported divine, mystical or other special relationships between a number and some coinciding observed (or perceived) events.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes OB-/OC-/OF-/OP-

words.tr: adj. 顽固的；执拗的；冷酷无情的
words.ex: He is obdurate and refuses to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他固执己见，拒绝改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as obdurate, you mean that they are determined not to change their mind or attitude in spite of efforts to persuade them.

words.ex: The leaf occluded the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 叶子堵住了管道。
words.en: To occlude means to block or stop up a passage, opening, or vessel.

words.tr: v. 消灭；毁掉；清除；抹除
words.ex: The bomb will obliterate the building.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹会摧毁那栋大楼。
words.en: To obliterate something means to remove all signs of it or to destroy it completely.

words.tr: adj. 侮辱的；辱骂的；鄙俗的
words.ex: He shouted opprobrious words at the driver.
words.ex_cn: 他向司机喊出辱骂的话。
words.en: Expressing scorn or criticism; conveying disgrace or shame.

words.tr: v. （故意地）混淆；使混乱；使困惑
words.ex: He tries to obfuscate the truth with complicated words.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用复杂的词语混淆真相。
words.en: To obfuscate something means to deliberately make it unclear or difficult to understand.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes OLIG-

words.tr: n. 商品供应垄断；卖方市场
words.ex: The market is an oligopoly controlled by three big companies.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场由三家大公司控制，属于商品供应垄断。
words.en: An oligopoly is a state of limited competition, in which a market is shared by a small number of producers or sellers.

words.tr: n. 寡头政治；寡头统治集团；寡头统治的国家
words.ex: The country is ruled by an oligarchy of wealthy businessmen.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家由一群富有的商人寡头统治。
words.en: A form of government in which all power is vested in a few persons or in a dominant class or clique; government by the few.

words.tr: adj. [昆] 寡食性的; [昆] 寡食性的
words.ex: The insect is oligophagous and eats only three types of plants.
words.ex_cn: 这种昆虫是寡食性的，只吃三种植物。
words.en: Feeding on a limited variety of food, especially a limited variety of plants.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes OMNI-

words.tr: adj. 全能的；无所不能的
words.ex: The god is omnipotent.
words.ex_cn: 这个神是无所不能的。
words.en: Having unlimited power, able to do anything.

words.ex: Bears are omnivorous animals.
words.ex_cn: 熊是杂食动物。
words.en: An omnivorous animal or person eats both plants and meat.

words.tr: adj. 无所不在的；遍及各处的
words.ex: The smell of bread is omnipresent in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨面包的香味无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something as omnipresent, you mean that it seems to be everywhere at the same time.

words.tr: adj. 全知的；无所不知的
words.ex: The omniscient narrator knows everything about the characters.
words.ex_cn: 全知的叙述者了解角色的一切。
words.en: Knowing everything; having infinite awareness, understanding, and insight.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes OPER

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: The operon controls gene expression in bacteria.
words.ex_cn: 操纵子控制细菌中的基因表达。
words.en: An operon is a functioning unit of genomic DNA containing a cluster of genes under the control of a single promoter.

words.tr:
adj. 起作用的；运作中的
n. 技工；密探；特工
words.ex: The operative plan is to start tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 实施的计划是明天开始。
words.en: An operative system or plan is one that is in use or being used. An operative is someone who works for a government agency or a private company, often doing secret or confidential work.

words.ex: He found the operose task too slow.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得这个繁琐的任务太慢了。
words.en: If you describe something as operose, you mean that it involves a lot of effort or hard work.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes OPTI/OPTO

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.tr: n. 眼镜商；验光师；眼镜商店
words.ex: He visited the optician to get new glasses.
words.ex_cn: 他去眼镜店配了新眼镜。
words.en: A person who makes or sells eyeglasses and other optical instruments.

words.tr: n. 验光；[眼科] 视力测定法
words.ex: He is studying optometry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习视光学。
words.en: Optometry is the practice or profession of examining the eyes for visual defects and prescribing corrective lenses.

words.ex: The scientist tried to find an optogram in the victim's eye.
words.ex_cn: 科学家试图在受害者的眼睛里找到一张视网膜图像。
words.en: An optogram is an image fixed on the retina of the eye, typically after death, which can sometimes be used to determine the last thing a person saw.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes ORTHO-

words.ex: He follows the orthodox religious practices.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循正统的宗教习俗。
words.en: Orthodox beliefs, methods, or systems are ones which are accepted or used by most people.

words.tr: n. 正当的作法；矫形术（等于 orthopraxia）
words.ex: He practices orthopraxy by following the rituals every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天遵循仪式来实践正行。
words.en: Orthopraxy refers to correct practice or action, especially in a religious context, as opposed to orthodoxy, which refers to correct belief.

words.ex: He is studying orthodontics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习正畸学。
words.en: Orthodontics is a branch of dentistry that deals with the diagnosis, prevention, and correction of malpositioned teeth and jaws.

words.ex: He has orthognathism, so his jaw aligns perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 他有正颌，所以他的下颌完全对齐。
words.en: Orthognathism refers to the condition of having a straight jaw or the correct alignment of the jaw.

words.tr: adj. 整形外科的；矫形术的
words.ex: He visits the orthopedic doctor for his knee pain.
words.ex_cn: 他去看骨科医生治疗他的膝盖疼痛。
words.en: relating to the branch of medicine dealing with the correction of deformities of bones or muscles

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes OS/OSS/OST/OSTEO

words.ex: The osseous tissue supports the body.
words.ex_cn: 骨组织支撑身体。
words.en: Of, relating to, or consisting of bone.

words.ex: The old rules have ossified over time.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧规则随着时间的推移变得僵化了。
words.en: To ossify means to change or develop into bone, or to become fixed and unable to change or develop.

words.ex: He has osteitis in his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他的腿有骨髓炎。
words.en: Osteitis is a medical condition characterized by inflammation of the bone.

words.tr: n. 骨化；成骨；（思想的）僵化
words.ex: The bone shows signs of ossification.
words.ex_cn: 这根骨头显示出骨化的迹象。
words.en: Ossification is the process by which bone is formed, or the process by which something becomes fixed and unable to change.

words.ex: He has a small osteoma on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的前额有一个小骨瘤。
words.en: A benign tumor composed of bone tissue.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PAC

words.ex: The two countries made a pact to stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家达成了一项停止战斗的协议。
words.en: A pact is a formal agreement between two or more people, organizations, or governments to do a particular thing or to help each other.

words.tr:
