n. 和平主义者；反战主义者
adj. 非战主义的
words.ex: He is a pacifist and refuses to fight in wars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名和平主义者，拒绝参与战争。
words.en: A pacifist is someone who believes that war and violence are unjustifiable and that disputes should be settled by peaceful means.

words.ex: He tried to pacify the crying baby with a toy.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用一个玩具让哭闹的婴儿安静下来。
words.en: If you pacify someone who is angry, upset, or not pleased, you make them calm or content.

words.ex: The two countries signed a pacific agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项和平协议。
words.en: A pacific person, country, or policy is peaceful and seeks to avoid conflict.

words.tr: n. 和解；平定；讲和；绥靖
words.ex: The government tried pacification after the riots.
words.ex_cn: 政府在骚乱后尝试了安抚。
words.en: The act of bringing peace to a place or ending war or violence.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PAL/PALEO

words.ex: He loves paleontology and finds dinosaur bones.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱古生物学，寻找恐龙骨头。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with fossil animals and plants.

words.tr: n. 古文书，古文书学；古字体
words.ex: He studies paleography to read old manuscripts.
words.ex_cn: 他研究古文字学以阅读古老手稿。
words.en: Paleography is the study of ancient writing systems and the deciphering and dating of historical manuscripts.

words.ex: He studies paleology to learn about ancient life.
words.ex_cn: 他研究古生物学以了解古代生命。
words.en: The study of ancient cultures, especially through their artifacts.

words.tr: adj. 古遗传学的：与古遗传学（研究古代生物遗传信息的科学）有关的。
words.ex: The paleogenetic data shows ancient climate changes.
words.ex_cn: 古遗传数据展示了古代的气候变化。
words.en: Relating to the study of genetic material from ancient organisms.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PAN-

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: He thinks this new pill is a panacea for all diseases.
words.ex_cn: 他认为这种新药是治百病的万应药。
words.en: A panacea is a remedy for all diseases or ills.

words.ex: The Pantheon is an ancient temple in Rome.
words.ex_cn: 万神庙是罗马的一座古代神庙。
words.en: A pantheon is a group of particularly respected, famous, or important people, or a temple dedicated to all the gods of a particular polytheistic religion.

words.tr: n. 巨大的数量（或收藏品）
words.ex: The festival showed a panoply of colorful costumes.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日展示了丰富多彩的服装。
words.en: A panoply is a complete or impressive collection of things or a splendid display.

words.ex: The pandemic caused many schools to close.
words.ex_cn: 这场流行病导致许多学校关闭。
words.en: A pandemic is an occurrence of a disease that affects many people over a wide area.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PAR

words.ex: The parable of the Good Samaritan teaches compassion and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 好撒玛利亚人的寓言教导了同情和善良。
words.en: A simple story used to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson, as told by Jesus in the Gospels.

words.ex: The parity of the numbers is important in this game.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的奇偶性在这个游戏中很重要。
words.en: If there is parity between two things, they are equal to each other.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一双鞋。
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: There is a disparity in pay between men and women.
words.ex_cn: 男女之间的工资存在差异。
words.en: A disparity between two or more things is a noticeable difference between them.

words.tr: n. （以往南非的）种族隔离制度
words.ex: He lived under apartheid in South Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他在南非生活在种族隔离制度下。
words.en: A policy or system of segregation or discrimination on grounds of race, especially the policy that was in place in South Africa from 1948 to 1994.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PARA-

words.ex: This experiment is a paradigm of scientific method.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验是科学方法的范例。
words.en: A paradigm is a model or pattern that is considered to be a typical example of something.

words.ex: The beach was paradisiacal with white sand and blue water.
words.ex_cn: 这片海滩有白色的沙子和蓝色的海水，宛如天堂。
words.en: If you describe a place as paradisiacal, you mean that it is like paradise.

words.tr: adj. 最高的；至上的；最重要的；
words.ex: His safety is paramount.
words.ex_cn: 他的安全是最重要的。
words.en: Something that is paramount or of paramount importance is more important than anything else.

words.ex: He is a paragon of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他是诚实的典范。
words.en: A paragon is someone who is considered to be a perfect example of a particular quality.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PAS/PATH

words.ex: He showed apathy toward the news.
words.ex_cn: 他对这则新闻漠不关心。
words.en: Apathy is a lack of feeling, emotion, interest, or concern about something. It is a state of indifference, or the suppression of emotions such as concern, excitement, motivation, or passion.

words.ex: He felt antipathy toward the loud neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他对那个吵闹的邻居感到反感。
words.en: A deep-seated feeling of dislike; aversion.

words.tr: n. 怜悯；悲情；哀婉；凄楚
words.ex: The movie filled us with pathos.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影让我们充满感动。
words.en: Pathos is a quality in a work of art or literature that evokes feelings of pity or sadness.

words.ex: The pathogen caused the outbreak of the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种病原体引发了疾病的爆发。
words.en: A pathogen is any organism or substance, especially a microorganism, capable of causing disease, such as bacteria, viruses, protozoa, or fungi.

words.tr: adj. 不动感情的；冷静的；平心静气的
words.ex: She remained dispassionate throughout the heated debate.
words.ex_cn: 她在激烈的辩论中始终保持冷静。
words.en: If you are dispassionate, you are able to act calmly and reasonably and not be influenced by your feelings or by personal opinions.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PATER/PATR

words.tr: n. 父亲的身份（或地位）
words.ex: The DNA test confirmed his paternity of the child.
words.ex_cn: DNA测试证实了他作为孩子父亲的身份。
words.en: The state of being a father; fatherhood.

words.tr: v. 惠顾；资助；屈尊俯就
words.ex: He often patronizes the local bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他经常光顾这家本地面包店。
words.en: If someone patronizes you, they speak or behave towards you in a way which seems friendly, but which shows that they think they are superior to you in some way.

words.ex: The company received patronage from a local businessman.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司收到了一位本地商人的赞助。
words.en: The support, encouragement, privilege, or financial aid that an organization or individual bestows to another.

words.tr: n. 杀父；杀父者；杀父罪
words.ex: The prince committed patricide to take the throne.
words.ex_cn: 王子为了登上王位而杀死了自己的父亲。
words.en: Patricide is the act of killing one's own father.

words.tr: n. 遗产；祖传的财物；继承物
words.ex: He inherited his father's patrimony.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了他父亲的遗产。
words.en: Property inherited from one's father or ancestors; heritage.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PED

words.tr: n. 迂腐之人；书呆子；学究
words.ex: He is a pedant who corrects every small mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他是个挑剔的书呆子，会纠正每一个小错误。
words.en: A pedant is a person who is excessively concerned with minor details and rules or with displaying academic learning.

words.ex: He gave a pedantic answer about grammar rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对语法规则给出了一个迂腐的答案。
words.en: If you describe someone as pedantic, you mean that they are too concerned with unimportant details or traditional rules, especially in connection with academic subjects.

words.tr: n. 施教者；好为人师的人；卖弄学问者
words.ex: The pedagogue taught children to read and write.
words.ex_cn: 这位教师教孩子们读书写字。
words.en: A pedagogue is a teacher, especially one who is strict or old-fashioned in their methods.

words.ex: He works in pedodontics at the children's hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在儿童医院从事儿童牙科工作。
words.en: Pedodontics is the branch of dentistry dealing with the care and treatment of children's teeth.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PED/POD

words.ex: The shoe has a pediform shape.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋具有足形的形状。
words.en: Resembling a foot in shape.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.tr: adj. 鸟足状的；有脚的；脚状的
words.ex: The information is too pedate to use.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息太过时了，无法使用。
words.en: Having lobes or divisions arranged like the toes of a foot.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PEL/PULS

words.tr: adj. 鸟足状的；有脚的；脚状的
words.ex: The information is too pedate to use.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息太过时了，无法使用。
words.en: Having lobes or divisions arranged like the toes of a foot.

words.tr: adj. 让人不愉快的；防……的（等于 repellent）; n. 驱虫剂；防水剂（等于 repe...
words.ex: The bug repellant keeps mosquitoes away.
words.ex_cn: 驱虫剂能驱赶蚊子。
words.en: A repellant is a substance that is used to keep insects or other pests away. It can also describe something that causes strong dislike or aversion.

words.tr: n. 推进剂；发射药；火箭燃料
words.ex: The rocket uses a strong propellant to fly.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用一种强大的推进剂来飞行。
words.en: A propellant is a substance that is used to move something forward, especially a rocket or a bullet, by creating a force that pushes it.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PER-

words.tr: vt. 游历；漫游；旅行; vi. 徒步旅行
words.ex: He likes to peregrinate through small towns.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在小镇间漫游。
words.en: To travel or wander around from place to place.

words.ex: The doctor used a percutaneous needle to collect the sample.
words.ex_cn: 医生用经皮针采集了样本。
words.en: Percutaneous refers to a medical procedure where access to inner organs or other tissue is done via needle puncture of the skin, rather than by using an 'open' approach where inner organs or tissue are exposed.

words.tr: adj. 可渗透的；可渗入的；
words.ex: The soil is permeable, so water passes through easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤是可渗透的，所以水很容易通过。
words.en: If a substance is permeable, it allows liquids or gases to pass through it.

words.ex: The smell of flowers was pervasive in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 花的香味遍布整个花园。
words.en: Something that is pervasive is present or noticeable throughout a place or thing.

words.ex: The smell of bread permeate the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
words.en: If something permeates a place, it spreads throughout it.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PERI-

words.ex: The periosteal layer covers the bone.
words.ex_cn: 骨膜层覆盖在骨头表面。
words.en: Relating to the periosteum, the dense layer of vascular connective tissue enveloping the bones except at the surfaces of the joints.

words.tr: adj. 巡游的；到处走的；兼职的
words.ex: He is a peripatetic teacher who moves from town to town.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位四处奔波的老师，从一个城镇搬到另一个城镇。
words.en: If you have a peripatetic job or way of life, you travel around a lot, living or working in different places for short periods of time.

words.ex: Earth is at perihelion in January.
words.ex_cn: 地球在一月处于近日点。
words.en: The point in the orbit of a planet, asteroid, or comet at which it is closest to the sun.

words.ex: The satellite is at perigee today.
words.ex_cn: 今天卫星处于近地点。
words.en: The point in the orbit of the moon or a satellite at which it is nearest to the earth.

words.ex: He uses periphrasis to sound more polite.
words.ex_cn: 他使用迂回说法来显得更礼貌。
words.en: The use of indirect and circumlocutory speech or writing.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PET

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: The child's petulant behavior was a result of his frustration.
words.ex_cn: 孩子暴躁的行为是因他的沮丧所致。
words.en: If you describe someone as petulant, you mean that they get angry or annoyed in a childish or unreasonable way.

words.ex: The job is repetitive and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复且无聊。
words.en: Something that is repetitive involves doing the same thing over and over again.

words.tr: phrase. 预期理由；循环论证；把有待证明的命题本身作为论据的逻辑谬误
words.ex: He uses petitio principii when he says the book is true because it says so.
words.ex_cn: 当他声称这本书是真实的，因为书里这么说时，他就在使用循环论证。
words.en: A logical fallacy in which the premise of an argument assumes the truth of the conclusion instead of supporting it.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PHIL

words.ex: He is a philanthropist who gives money to poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位向贫困儿童捐款的慈善家。
words.en: A philanthropist is someone who helps others, especially by giving money to people who need it.

words.tr: n. 技术爱好者; 爱好技术的
words.ex: He is a technophile who loves new gadgets.
words.ex_cn: 他是个科技爱好者，喜欢新电子产品。
words.en: A technophile is a person who is enthusiastic about new technology.

words.tr: n. 爱慕女子的人；喜欢女子的人
words.ex: He is a philogynist who respects women deeply.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位非常尊重女性的女性主义者。
words.en: A man who loves or admires women.

words.tr: n. 对希腊友善的人；爱好希腊的人
words.ex: He is a philhellene who loves ancient Greek culture.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位热爱古希腊文化的希腊文化爱好者。
words.en: A philhellene is someone who loves Greece, its culture, or its people.

words.tr: n. [药]春药；催情药（等于 philter）; vt. 刺激；使兴奋
words.ex: She drank the philtre to make him love her.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了那剂魔药，让他爱上她。
words.en: A philtre is a potion or drug supposed to cause the person who takes it to fall in love with the person who gave it.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PHOB

words.ex: He has a phobia of spiders.
words.ex_cn: 他有对蜘蛛的恐怖病。
words.en: A phobia is an extreme or irrational fear of or aversion to something.

words.ex: He has arachnophobia and screams when he sees a spider.
words.ex_cn: 他有蜘蛛恐惧症，看到蜘蛛时会尖叫。
words.en: Arachnophobia is an intense and irrational fear of spiders and other arachnids such as scorpions.

words.tr: n. 广场恐惧症；旷野恐怖症
words.ex: He has agoraphobia and avoids crowded places.
words.ex_cn: 他患有广场恐惧症，避免去拥挤的地方。
words.en: Agoraphobia is an anxiety disorder characterized by an intense fear of being in situations from which escape might be difficult or embarrassing, or in which help may not be available in the event of a panic attack.

words.tr: adj. 引起幽闭恐怖的；（患）幽闭恐怖症的
words.ex: The small elevator made him feel claustrophobic.
words.ex_cn: 这个小电梯让他感到幽闭恐怖。
words.en: If you feel claustrophobic, you feel very uncomfortable or anxious when you are in a small, crowded, or enclosed place.

words.ex: He has hydrophobia and avoids water.
words.ex_cn: 他有恐水症，避免接触水。
words.en: Hydrophobia is a pathological fear of water, especially as a symptom of rabies in humans.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PHON

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.tr: n. 音标符号；录音片；语音图；形声字
words.ex: He learned the phonogram 'sh' in first grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在一年级学习了音标'sh'。
words.en: A phonogram is a symbol or character representing a sound, especially in a system of phonetic transcription.

words.ex: He learns phonic rules to read words.
words.ex_cn: 他学习语音规则来认读单词。
words.en: Phonic means relating to sound or to the sounds of speech.

words.tr:
n. 语音学
adj. 语音的；发音的
words.ex: He is learning phonetics to improve his pronunciation.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习语音学以改善发音。
words.en: Phonetics is the study of the sounds of human speech.

words.ex: The cacophony of car horns made it hard to think.
words.ex_cn: 汽车喇叭的刺耳噪音让人难以思考。
words.en: A cacophony is a mixture of loud and usually unpleasant sounds.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PHOS/PHOTO

words.ex: The plant is photosensitive and grows toward the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对光敏感，会朝向太阳生长。
words.en: A photosensitive material or device reacts to light by changing in some way.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: The moth shows phototaxis toward the light.
words.ex_cn: 飞蛾向光表现出趋光性。
words.en: The movement of an organism in response to light, either towards or away from it.

words.ex: He is a photophile who loves sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 他是个喜爱阳光的 photophile。
words.en: An organism that thrives in or prefers light environments.

words.tr: n. 光度测定研究，光度测定
words.ex: He uses photometry to measure light brightness.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光度法测量光的亮度。
words.en: Photometry is the science of the measurement of light, in terms of its perceived brightness to the human eye.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PHYS/PHYSIO

words.ex: He studies physiology to understand how the human body works.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生理学以了解人体如何运作。
words.en: The branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: He practices physiolatry by worshiping the human body.
words.ex_cn: 他通过崇拜人体来实践生理崇拜。
words.en: The worship of nature.

words.ex: He studies physiocracy in his economics class.
words.ex_cn: 他在经济学课上学习重农主义。
words.en: Physiocracy is an economic theory developed by a group of 18th-century French economists who believed that the wealth of nations was derived solely from the value of land agriculture or land development.

words.ex: His physiognomy showed kindness and calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的相貌展现出善良与平静。
words.en: The physiognomy of a person or animal is their face, especially when this is considered in relation to their character or temperament.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PICT

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.tr: n. 象形文字；象形图；古代石壁画
words.ex: The ancient people used pictograph to show stories.
words.ex_cn: 古代人用象形图来讲述故事。
words.en: A pictograph is a pictorial symbol for a word or phrase. Pictographs were used as the earliest known form of writing, examples having been discovered in Egypt and Mesopotamia from before 3000 BC.

words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.tr:
adj. 有图画的；图示的
n. 画报
words.ex: The book has a pictorial guide to plants.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一本植物的图解指南。
words.en: A pictorial representation or image is one that is made using pictures or shows things in a way that pictures do.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PLAC

words.tr: adj. 平静的；宁静的；温和的；
words.ex: The lake was placid in the morning light.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的阳光下，湖面平静无波。
words.en: A placid person or animal is calm and does not easily become excited, angry, or upset.

words.ex: He gave her flowers to placate her.
words.ex_cn: 他送她花来安抚她。
words.en: If you placate someone, you do or say something to make them stop feeling angry.

words.tr: adj. 不能和解的；不能平息的
words.ex: He is an implacable enemy who never forgives.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个永不原谅的不可调和的敌人。
words.en: If you say that someone is implacable, you mean that they have very strong feelings of hostility or disapproval which nobody can change.

words.tr: adj. 自满的；自鸣得意的
words.ex: He is complacent about his good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的好成绩感到自满。
words.en: A complacent person is very pleased with themselves or feels that they do not need to do anything about a situation, even though the situation may be uncertain or dangerous.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a placebo to see if his pain would go away.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一个安慰剂，看看他的疼痛是否会消失。
words.en: A substance that has no therapeutic effect, used as a control in testing new drugs, or given for its psychological effect to a patient who believes it to be a medicine.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes POLI

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.tr: adj. 大都市的；大城市的；
words.ex: He lives in a metropolitan city like New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约这样的大都市。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a metropolis or large city, especially as the main city of a country or region.

words.tr: adj. 全世界的；四海一家的；
words.ex: This city has a cosmopolitan population.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有着来自世界各地的人口。
words.en: A cosmopolitan place or society is full of people from many different countries and cultures.

words.ex: He is interested in political news.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治新闻感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.tr: n. 政体；国体；有组织的社会团体
words.ex: The small island has a stable polity.
words.ex_cn: 这个小岛有一个稳定的政体。
words.en: A polity is a society or country considered as a political entity, or the form of government or constitution of such an entity.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes POLY-

words.ex: The piece is characterized by its intricate polyphony.
words.ex_cn: 这首曲子以其复杂的复调为特征。
words.en: Polyphony is a type of musical texture consisting of two or more simultaneous lines of independent melody, as opposed to a musical texture with just one voice, monophony, or a texture with one dominant melodic voice accompanied by chords, homophony.

words.tr: adj. [生物] 多态的；[生物] 多形的；多形态的；[化学] 多晶形的（等于 polymorph...
words.ex: The species exhibits polymorphic characteristics.
words.ex_cn: 该物种表现出多态性特征。
words.en: A polymorphic organism or species has more than one form or type, especially in different stages of its life cycle or in different environments.

words.tr:
adj. 多种语言的；通晓数种语言的
n. 通晓数种语言的人
words.ex: He is a polyglot who speaks five languages.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位会说五种语言的多语者。
words.en: A polyglot is a person who knows and is able to use several languages.

words.ex: Polygamy is illegal in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 一夫多妻制在许多国家是非法的。
words.en: Polygamy is the custom or practice of having more than one wife or husband at the same time.

words.tr: n. 多神论者；多神教徒; adj. 多神论者的
words.ex: He was a polytheist who worshipped multiple gods.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个崇拜多神的信徒。
words.en: A polytheist is a person who believes in or worships more than one god.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PON/POS

words.ex: He composes music in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.ex: The table is made of a composite material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由一种合成材料制成的。
words.en: A composite is something that is made up of several different parts or materials.

words.ex: He opposes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: If you oppose someone or something, you disagree with them and try to prevent them from doing something, or you try to change what they are doing.

words.ex: After work, she found repose in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，她在花园里休息。
words.en: A state of rest, sleep, or tranquility. To lie or be placed in a particular position or manner.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes POPUL

words.tr: v. 居住于；生活于；移民于
words.ex: Many people populate this small town.
words.ex_cn: 许多人居住在这个小镇上。
words.en: To populate an area means to live in it or to fill it with people or things.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: The populace enjoyed the free concert in the park.
words.ex_cn: 平民们享受了公园里的免费音乐会。
words.en: The general public; the common people.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr: adj. 人口众多的；人口密集的
words.ex: China is a populous country.
words.ex_cn: 中国是一个人口众多的国家。
words.en: If a place is populous, it has a large population.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PORT

words.tr: n. 搬运；运输; vi. 转到陆上运输; vt. 转到陆上运输；经陆上运输绕过
words.ex: The canoe was carried over the portage.
words.ex_cn: 独木舟被运过了搬运道。
words.en: The act or process of carrying boats or goods overland from one body of water to another.

words.tr: n. 入门；大门；入口网站
words.ex: This book is a portal to learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是学习英语的入门。
words.en: A portal is a large and imposing entrance, doorway, or gate, or a website that provides access or links to other sites.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr: v. 驱逐出境；使举止得体
words.ex: They will deport him for breaking the law.
words.ex_cn: 他们将因他违法而驱逐他。
words.en: If a government deports someone, usually someone who is not a citizen of that country, it sends them out of the country because they have committed a crime or because it believes they do not have the right to be there.

words.ex: He showed his portfolio to the art teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向美术老师展示了他作品集。
words.en: A portfolio is a set of pictures by someone, or photographs of examples of their work, which they use when entering competitions or applying for work.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes POST-

words.ex: He wrote the book for posterity.
words.ex_cn: 他写这本书是为了留给后人。
words.en: All future generations of people.

words.tr: adj. （时间、次序）较后的；后面的；背面的；
words.ex: The posterior chapter explains the final result.
words.ex_cn: 后面的章节解释了最终结果。
words.en: Located behind a part or toward the rear of something.

words.tr: adj. （圣经上）大洪水后的; n. 世界大洪水后幸存的人或物
words.ex: The artifacts found in the excavation are believed to be postdiluvian.
words.ex_cn: 在挖掘中发现的人工制品被认为是洪水后的。
words.en: Relating to or occurring in the period following a great flood, especially the Biblical Flood.

words.tr: adj. 死后的；死后出版的；遗腹的
words.ex: He received a posthumous award for his bravery.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢而被追授了奖项。
words.en: Posthumous means occurring, awarded, or appearing after the death of the originator.

words.tr: phrase. /adj. 事后的；在事实发生之后的
words.ex: The report was written post factum, analyzing the events that had already occurred.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告是事后写的，分析了已经发生的事件。
words.en: After the fact; occurring or done after the event.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PRE-

words.ex: Prenatal care is crucial for the health of both the mother and the baby.
words.ex_cn: 产前护理对母亲和婴儿的健康至关重要。
words.en: Prenatal means relating to the medical care given to pregnant women before their babies are born.

words.ex: The rain precludes a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 下雨阻止了野餐。
words.en: If something precludes an event or action, it prevents it from happening.

words.ex: The premise of his argument is that everyone is equal.
words.ex_cn: 他论点的前提是人人平等。
words.en: A premise is a statement or idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument.

words.tr: n. (尤指道德方面的)戒律；准则
words.ex: He follows the precept to be kind every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天遵循要善良的教诲。
words.en: A precept is a general rule intended to regulate behavior or thought.

words.ex: The court followed the precedent set in 1995.
words.ex_cn: 法院遵循了1995年确立的先例。
words.en: A precedent is an action or decision that is used as an example when someone wants to do a similar thing in the future.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PREHEND/PREHENS

words.ex: The teacher reprehended the student for his disruptive behavior.
words.ex_cn: 老师因学生扰乱课堂的行为而责备他。
words.en: If you reprehend someone, you criticize them severely for their actions or behavior.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: He felt apprehension before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到焦虑。
words.en: Anxiety or fear that something bad or unpleasant will happen; understanding; the action of arresting someone.

words.tr: adj. 可盘卷的；能抓住的；有理解能力的；贪婪的
words.ex: The monkey has a prehensile tail to grab trees.
words.ex_cn: 这只猴子有一条能抓握的尾巴来抓住树木。
words.en: A prehensile tail or limb is adapted for grasping or holding.

words.ex: His comprehension of the story was very good.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事的理解很好。
words.en: Comprehension is the ability to understand something.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PRIM

words.tr: phrase. 初步的；表面上的；基于初步印象的；无需进一步证明即可成立的
words.ex: The evidence seems to support a prima facie case of negligence.
words.ex_cn: 证据似乎支持一个乍看之下的疏忽案件。
words.en: Based on the first impression; accepted as correct until proved otherwise.

words.ex: The forest looked primeval and untouched.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林看起来远古而未被破坏。
words.en: relating to the earliest ages of the world or the universe; ancient or prehistoric.

words.tr: adj. 原始的；远古的；最初的
words.ex: The primordial soup formed the first life on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 原始汤形成了地球上的最初生命。
words.en: Primordial means existing at or from the beginning of time; primeval.

words.tr: n. 长子身份；长子继承权
words.ex: In many historical societies, primogeniture dictated that the eldest son would inherit the family estate.
words.ex_cn: 在许多历史社会中，长子继承权规定长子将继承家族的地产。
words.en: The system by which the eldest son in a family inherits all his parents' property.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PRO-

words.tr: phrase. 按需要；必要时；临时地（医学处方用语，缩写为p.r.n.）
words.ex: The medication should be administered pro re nata.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物应根据需要服用。
words.en: As needed; according to the circumstances.

words.tr: n. 支持者；拥护者；辩护者
words.ex: He is a proponent of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁能源的支持者。
words.en: A proponent of an idea or course of action is someone who supports it and tries to persuade other people to support it.

words.ex: The boy is a piano prodigy at age six.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩六岁时就是一位钢琴奇才。
words.en: A prodigy is someone who is unusually young and has a great natural ability in a particular area.

words.ex: He has a propensity for telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他有说实话的倾向。
words.en: A propensity is a natural tendency to behave in a particular way.

words.ex: He has a proclivity for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有解决数学问题的倾向。
words.en: A proclivity is a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or to like a particular thing.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PROTO-

words.ex: The protogenic elements of the universe were formed shortly after the Big Bang.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙的原生元素在大爆炸后不久形成。
words.en: Relating to or being the first or earliest of its kind; original.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.ex: The protomorphic fossils provide insights into early life forms.
words.ex_cn: 原形态化石为早期生命形式提供了见解。
words.en: Being the earliest or most primitive form of something.

words.tr: n. [细胞] 原生质体；原人；原物
words.ex: The protoplast is the fundamental unit of life.
words.ex_cn: 原生质体是生命的基本单位。
words.en: The protoplast is the living part of a cell, excluding the cell wall, consisting of the cytoplasm and nucleus.

words.ex: The protolithic period marked the beginning of human civilization.
words.ex_cn: 原始石器时代标志着人类文明的开端。
words.en: Relating to the earliest stage of a rock's formation.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PSEUDO-

words.ex: He writes books under a pseudonym.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔名写书。
words.en: A pseudonym is a name that someone, especially a writer, uses instead of their real name.

words.ex: The patient reported experiencing pseudopsia, seeing shapes and colors that were not actually present.
words.ex_cn: 病人报告说出现了幻视，看到了实际并不存在的形状和颜色。
words.en: A visual illusion or hallucination, where one sees things that are not actually present.

words.tr: n. 不经之谈，错误的看法
words.ex: She dismissed his ideas as mere pseudodox.
words.ex_cn: 她认为他的想法只不过是不经之谈。
words.en: A pseudodox is a false or erroneous doctrine or belief.

words.tr: n. 伪形；假象；[土壤] 假晶
words.ex: The mineral displayed a pseudomorph after the original crystal structure had been replaced.
words.ex_cn: 这种矿物质显示了原晶体结构被替换后的假晶形态。
words.en: A pseudomorph is a mineral that has the external crystal form of another mineral species, having been formed by a process of pseudomorphism.

words.ex: Pseudocyesis is a condition where a woman experiences pregnancy symptoms without actually being pregnant.
words.ex_cn: 假孕是一种女性在没有真正怀孕的情况下经历妊娠症状的情况。
words.en: Pseudocyesis is a condition in which a woman believes she is pregnant when she is not.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PSYCH

words.ex: The child's psyche was affected by the loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的心灵受到了嘈杂声音的影响。
words.en: The human soul, mind, or spirit.

words.tr: adj. 精神的；灵魂的；心理的；通灵的；
words.ex: He has a psychic connection with his twin brother.
words.ex_cn: 他和双胞胎兄弟有精神上的联系。
words.en: Relating to or denoting faculties or phenomena that are apparently inexplicable by natural laws, especially involving telepathy or clairvoyance.

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.tr: adj. （药物）引起幻觉的；使人精神恍惚的；（艺术、音乐、服装等）产生迷幻效果的
words.ex: The psychedelic drug made him see colorful shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这种致幻药物让他看到了五彩斑斓的形状。
words.en: relating to or denoting drugs (especially LSD) that produce hallucinations and apparent expansion of consciousness

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PUB

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.ex: France is a republic with a president.
words.ex_cn: 法国是一个有总统的共和国。
words.en: A republic is a country where power is held by the people or their elected representatives, and which has an elected or nominated president rather than a monarch.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: He wants to publish a book next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年出版一本书。
words.en: To produce and issue printed material for public distribution or sale; to make information or work available to the public.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PUNCT

words.tr: adj. 谨小慎微的；一丝不苟的
words.ex: He is punctilious about following every rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对遵守每一条规则都谨小慎微。
words.en: If someone is punctilious, they are very careful to behave correctly and to follow the details of rules or customs.

words.tr: n. 拘泥形式；细节；拘束
words.ex: He was known for his punctilio in observing formalities.
words.ex_cn: 他以拘泥于形式而闻名。
words.en: A punctilio is a fine point of conduct or a detail of etiquette.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.tr:
n. 刺穿；刺孔
v. 刺穿；削弱
words.ex: The bike tire has a puncture.
words.ex_cn: 自行车轮胎有一个漏气孔。
words.en: A puncture is a small hole made by a sharp object, especially in a tire. To puncture something means to make a hole in it with a sharp object.

words.tr: adj. 有小点的，点状的；有小孔的；具点的；有凹陷的
words.ex: The surface of the leaf was covered with punctate markings.
words.ex_cn: 叶子的表面覆盖着点状的标记。
words.en: Marked with or as if with dots; having tiny spots or depressions.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes PUT/PUTAT

words.tr: adj. 推定的；假定的；一般认为的
words.ex: The putative father was asked to take a DNA test.
words.ex_cn: 被推定的父亲被要求做DNA测试。
words.en: Generally believed to be or to exist, but not proved to be so.

words.tr:
n. 名声；名誉；名望
v. 认为；以为
words.ex: He is of good repute in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他在镇上声誉很好。
words.en: The opinion generally held of someone or something; the state of being regarded in a particular way.

words.tr:
adj. 据说的；号称的；有名气的
v. 认为；以为；“repute”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is a reputed doctor in this city.
words.ex_cn: 他是这座城市里有名的医生。
words.en: Generally believed to be a particular thing, although this might not be true.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes QUER/QUES/QUIR/QUIS

words.tr:
n. 询问；疑问；问号
v. 询问；怀疑
words.ex: He made a query about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了公交车的时刻表。
words.en: A query is a question, especially one that you ask in order to check that something is true or correct.

words.ex: The court held an inquest into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 法院对这起事故进行了审讯。
words.en: An inquest is an official investigation to discover the cause of something, especially a death.

words.ex: The inquisition into the company's financial records uncovered fraudulent activities.
words.ex_cn: 对公司财务记录的调查揭露了欺诈行为。
words.en: An inquisition is an official investigation, especially one which is very thorough and uses harsh methods.

words.ex: The inquirer sought to uncover the truth behind the rumors.
words.ex_cn: 调查者试图揭开谣言背后的真相。
words.en: A person who asks questions or seeks information.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必备的；必不可少的；
words.ex: A passport is a requisite for international travel.
words.ex_cn: 护照是国际旅行所必需的。
words.en: Something that is necessary for a particular purpose.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes RE-

words.tr: v. 撤回声明；放弃信仰
words.ex: He recanted his statement after seeing the evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他在看到证据后撤回了他的话。
words.en: If you recant, you say publicly that you no longer hold a set of beliefs that you had in the past.

words.ex: He rebut the claim with clear evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的证据反驳了这一说法。
words.en: If you rebut a charge or criticism that is made against you, you give reasons why it is untrue or unacceptable.

words.ex: He tried to retract his words after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后试图收回他的话。
words.en: If you retract something that you have said or written, you say that you did not mean it.

words.ex: The recurrence of storms caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的反复出现造成了许多问题。
words.en: The return of a sign, symptom, or disease after a remission.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes RECT

words.ex: They erect a flagpole in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里竖立一根旗杆。
words.en: If people erect something such as a building, bridge, or barrier, they build it or create it.

words.tr: adj. 勃起的；[昆] 可使直立的
words.ex: The doctor examined the patient's erectile tissue.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了患者的勃起组织。
words.en: Capable of being raised to an upright position; especially: capable of being caused to stand up or become firm (as the penis) by filling with blood.

words.ex: His rectitude in business dealings was well-known.
words.ex_cn: 他在商业交易中的正直是众所周知的。
words.en: Moral integrity; honesty and correctness of judgement or behaviour.

words.tr: adj. 直线运动的；形成直线的；用直线围着的
words.ex: The building has a rectilinear design with sharp, straight lines.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑具有直线设计，线条锐利、笔直。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by straight lines.

words.tr: n. （书中的）右页；纸张的正面; n. （Recto）人名；（西、葡）雷克托
words.ex: The image was printed on the recto of the page.
words.ex_cn: 图片被印在了纸张的正面。
words.en: The right-hand page of an open book, or the front side of a leaf.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes RECT/REG/REGN

words.tr: n. 教区长；教区牧师；校长；院长
words.ex: The rector gave a sermon every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 教区长每周日都布道。
words.en: A rector is a person in charge of a parish in the Church of England or in the Episcopal Church, or a person in charge of a university or college.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes RETRO-

words.tr:
n. 回想
v. 回想
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回顾过去，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.tr:
adj. 倒退的；退化的；退步的
v. 逆行；倒退；堕落
words.ex: The company's retrograde policies led to a decline in productivity.
words.ex_cn: 公司倒退的政策导致了生产力的下降。
words.en: If you describe an action or idea as retrograde, you disapprove of it because it returns to old ideas or methods and does not take advantage of recent progress.

words.ex: The law is retroactive and covers last year.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律具有追溯效力，适用于去年。
words.en: If a decision, action, or law is retroactive, it is intended to take effect from a date before it was actually made.

words.ex: He retrojected the idea to its original context.
words.ex_cn: 他将这个想法回溯到其原始背景。
words.en: To attribute (a current feeling, idea, etc.) to a past time or event.

words.tr: n. [病毒] 逆转录酶病毒（一种致肿瘤病毒）
words.ex: Retroviruses are known to cause certain types of cancer.
words.ex_cn: 逆转录病毒被认为会引起某些类型的癌症。
words.en: A retrovirus is a type of virus that inserts a copy of its RNA genome into the DNA of a host cell that it invades, thus changing the genome of that cell.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes RID/RIS

words.ex: They deride him for wearing old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们嘲笑他穿旧衣服。
words.en: If you deride someone or something, you say that they are stupid or have no value.

words.ex: He faced ridicule for wearing old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为穿旧衣服而遭到嘲笑。
words.en: To ridicule someone or something means to make fun of them in an unkind way.

words.ex: The crowd laughed in derision when he fell down.
words.ex_cn: 当他摔倒时，人群发出嘲笑的笑声。
words.en: If you treat someone or something with derision, you express contempt for them; ridicule.

words.ex: It's ridiculous to think he can run a mile in one minute.
words.ex_cn: 认为他能在一分钟内跑完一英里是荒谬的。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is ridiculous, you mean that they are very foolish.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes ROG

words.tr:
n. 质问；讯问
adj. 质问的；疑问的
words.ex: The lawyer sent an interrogatory to the witness.
words.ex_cn: 律师向证人提出了质问。
words.en: An interrogatory is a formal question or set of questions, especially in a legal context, aimed at obtaining information or evidence.

words.ex: It is the president's prerogative to make final decisions.
words.ex_cn: 做最终决定是总统的特权。
words.en: A prerogative is a right or privilege exclusive to a particular individual or class.

words.tr: adj. 查询的；调查的；请求的
words.ex: The rogatory letter was sent to gather more information about the case.
words.ex_cn: 这封查询信是为了收集更多关于此案的信息。
words.en: Relating to or involving an inquiry or investigation.

words.ex: The rogation days were traditionally observed with fasting and prayer.
words.ex_cn: 祈祷日传统上是通过斋戒和祈祷来遵守的。
words.en: Rogation refers to the act of asking or supplicating, especially in a religious context, for blessings or guidance.

words.ex: His derogatory remarks hurt her feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他毁谤的言辞伤害了她的感情。
words.en: If you make a derogatory remark or comment about someone or something, you say something that shows you have a low opinion of them.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SACR/SANCT

words.tr: n. 避难所；庇护所；庇护；
words.ex: The birds found sanctuary in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在森林里找到了避难所。
words.en: A sanctuary is a place where people or animals are protected from danger or trouble.

words.ex: They pray to sanctify the new home.
words.ex_cn: 他们祈祷来圣化这个新家。
words.en: To sanctify something means to make it holy or to purify it, often through a religious ceremony or blessing.

words.tr:
n. 批准；允许；认可；制裁；处罚
v. 批准；认可；制裁；处罚
words.ex: The company got official sanction to open a new branch.
words.ex_cn: 该公司获得了开设新分公司的正式批准。
words.en: A sanction is a penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or an official permission or approval for an action.

words.tr: adj. 极神圣的；神圣不可侵犯的
words.ex: The church's rules were considered sacrosanct and unchangeable.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的规定被认为是神圣不可侵犯的，不可改变的。
words.en: If you describe something as sacrosanct, you mean that it is considered to be special and should not be changed or interfered with.

words.tr: adj. 装作圣洁的；伪善的
words.ex: He gave a sanctimonious speech about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一番关于诚实的伪善演讲。
words.en: If you describe someone as sanctimonious, you disapprove of them because you think that they are trying to appear morally better than other people.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SCI

words.tr: n. 一知半解，浅薄的知识
words.ex: His sciolism on the subject was evident in his superficial remarks.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个主题的一知半解在他肤浅的评论中显而易见。
words.en: Superficial knowledge or learning, especially when pretentiously displayed.

words.ex: He is a conscientious student who always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个尽责的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is conscientious is very careful to do their work properly.

words.tr: adj. 预知的；有先见之明的
words.ex: His prescient warning saved many lives.
words.ex_cn: 他那有先见之明的警告挽救了许多生命。
words.en: Having or showing knowledge of events before they take place.

words.ex: His nescience of the local culture led to many misunderstandings.
words.ex_cn: 他对当地文化的一无所知导致了许多误解。
words.en: Nescience refers to the lack of knowledge or awareness; ignorance.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SCOP

words.ex: His nescience of the local culture led to many misunderstandings.
words.ex_cn: 他对当地文化的一无所知导致了许多误解。
words.en: Nescience refers to the lack of knowledge or awareness; ignorance.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.ex: The submarine used a periscope to observe the surface.
words.ex_cn: 潜艇使用潜望镜观察水面。
words.en: A periscope is an optical instrument that allows an observer to see things that are not in the direct line of sight, typically used in submarines to see above the water surface.

words.ex: The bacteria are microscopic.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌极小。
words.en: So small as to be visible only with a microscope; of or relating to a microscope.

words.ex: The doctor used a colonoscope to examine the patient's colon.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用结肠镜检查患者的结肠。
words.en: A colonoscope is a flexible tube with a light and a camera on the end used to examine the interior of the colon.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SCRIB/SCRIP

words.ex: They ascribe his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

words.ex: The law circumscribes what companies can do.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制了公司能做的事情。
words.en: To circumscribe something means to limit its size, activity, or scope, often by setting boundaries or restrictions.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.tr:
adj. 无可名状的；难以区别的；无特征的；极普通的
n. 无以名状；不属任何类型的人
words.ex: The building was nondescript, with no special features.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑无可名状，没有任何特别的特征。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as nondescript, you mean that their appearance is rather dull, and not at all interesting or attractive.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SE-

words.tr: v. 退出组织；脱离团体
words.ex: The state decided to secede from the union.
words.ex_cn: 该州决定脱离联邦。
words.en: To withdraw formally from membership in a federal union, an alliance, or a political or religious organization.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.ex: He lives in seclusion in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山里，过着与世隔绝的生活。
words.en: The state of being private and away from other people.

words.ex: He tried to seduce her with flowers and gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和礼物引诱她。
words.en: To seduce someone means to persuade them to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by making it seem attractive or exciting.

words.tr: adj. 遮遮掩掩的；守口如瓶的；
words.ex: He gave a secretive smile and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他露出一个遮遮掩掩的微笑，然后走开了。
words.en: If you are secretive, you like to have secrets and to keep your knowledge, feelings, or intentions hidden.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SEC/SECT/SEGM

words.ex: Marble is a sectile material, easily cut into various shapes.
words.ex_cn: 大理石是一种可切的材料，容易切割成各种形状。
words.en: Capable of being cut or divided into thin slices or sections.

words.ex: The teacher asked us to dissect the poem line by line.
words.ex_cn: 老师让我们逐行仔细分析这首诗。
words.en: To dissect something means to cut it into pieces in order to examine its structure, or to study something in great detail.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.tr:
adj. 切的；割的；交叉的
n. 正割；割线
words.ex: The secant line intersects the circle at two points.
words.ex_cn: 割线在两个点与圆相交。
words.en: In mathematics, a secant is a straight line that intersects a curve at two or more points.

words.ex: The worm has a segmented body.
words.ex_cn: 这条蠕虫的身体是分割的。
words.en: Divided into or composed of segments or sections.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SECU/SEQU

words.tr: n. 检察官；公诉人；起诉人；原告
words.ex: The prosecutor asked the witness questions.
words.ex_cn: 检察官向证人提问了。
words.en: A prosecutor is a lawyer who officially accuses someone of committing a crime by bringing a case against them in a court of law.

words.ex: The movie had a sequel that came out last year.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有一部去年上映的续集。
words.en: A sequel is a book, film, or play that continues the story of a previous one.

words.tr: adj. 不重要的；无关紧要的
words.ex: His comment was inconsequential to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的评论对决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as inconsequential, you mean that it is not important.

words.tr: adj. 奉承的；逢迎的；谄媚的
words.ex: He was obsequious to his boss to get a promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他为了得到晋升，对老板阿谀奉承。
words.en: If you describe someone as obsequious, you are criticizing them because they are too eager to help or agree with someone more important than them.

words.tr: adj. 前后一贯的；盲从的；无独立见解的
words.ex: His arguments were sequacious and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点前后一贯，容易理解。
words.en: If you describe someone as sequacious, you are criticizing them for being too ready to accept what other people say or for being too easily influenced by other people.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SEMI-

words.ex: The semiterrestrial species is adapted to living both on land and in water.
words.ex_cn: 这种半陆栖物种适应了在陆地和水中的生活。
words.en: Living partly on land and partly in water.

words.tr: adj. 每半年的；半年一次的
words.ex: The company holds semiannual meetings to update employees on recent developments.
words.ex_cn: 公司每半年举行一次会议，向员工通报最新进展。
words.en: occurring or payable twice each year

words.ex: The semiaquatic mammal thrives in wetlands.
words.ex_cn: 这种半水生哺乳动物在湿地中繁衍生息。
words.en: Partially aquatic; living or growing partly on land and partly in water.

words.ex: The child drew a semicircle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A semicircle is half of a circle, or something that has the shape of half a circle.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SENS/SENT

words.ex: The sensate world around us is filled with sights and sounds.
words.ex_cn: 我们周围的可感觉世界充满了视觉和听觉。
words.en: Relating to or involving the senses or sensation.

words.tr: adj. （对某事物）无感觉的；未察觉的；意识不到的；失去知觉的
words.ex: He was insensible after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了知觉。
words.en: If someone is insensible, they are not able to feel or notice something, often because they are unconscious or unaware.

words.ex: His sentiment about the new policy is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策的看法是积极的。
words.en: A sentiment is a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something.

words.tr: adj. 有知觉的；有感觉力的；
words.ex: The robot became sentient and could feel pain.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人变得有知觉，能够感受到疼痛。
words.en: A sentient being is capable of perception or feeling.

words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子很容易理解。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SOL

words.ex: The solarium on the roof provides a relaxing space for sunbathing.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的日光浴室提供了一个放松的日光浴空间。
words.en: A solarium is a room with large windows or glass walls that let in a lot of sunlight, often used for growing plants or for people to enjoy the sun.

words.tr: vt. 使……过度曝光; vi. 曝光过度
words.ex: The photographer accidentally solarized the image.
words.ex_cn: 摄影师不小心使图像曝光过度了。
words.en: To expose to the light of the sun; to overexpose to light, especially in photography.

words.ex: The solstice happens in June and December.
words.ex_cn: 夏至和冬至分别发生在六月和十二月。
words.en: The solstice is the time of the year when the sun is at its greatest distance from the celestial equator, occurring around June 21 and December 21.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.ex: The solarimeter is used to measure the total solar radiation.
words.ex_cn: 日射（总量）表用于测量总太阳辐射。
words.en: An instrument for measuring the intensity of solar radiation.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SOLV/SOLU

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.ex: Salt is soluble in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐可以溶于水。
words.en: A substance that is soluble can be dissolved in a liquid.

words.ex: Salt is a solute in seawater.
words.ex_cn: 盐是海水中的溶质。
words.en: A solute is a substance that is dissolved in a solvent to form a solution.

words.tr: n. 分解；分裂；溶解；解体；解除；死亡
words.ex: The dissolution of sugar in water is quick.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中的分解很快。
words.en: The act or process of ending or breaking up an organization, agreement, or legal arrangement.

words.tr: adj. 无决断的；犹豫不决的
words.ex: He was irresolute about which job to accept.
words.ex_cn: 他对于接受哪份工作犹豫不决。
words.en: If someone is irresolute, they are uncertain about what to do or are unable to make decisions.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SOMN

words.ex: The doctor specializes in treating somnambulance.
words.ex_cn: 这位医生专门治疗梦游症。
words.en: The condition of walking or performing other activities while asleep.

words.tr: n. 梦话；说梦话（等于 somniloquy）
words.ex: Her somniloquence often revealed her deepest fears.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦话常常揭示了她最深的恐惧。
words.en: The act of talking in one's sleep.

words.ex: He has insomnia and cannot sleep at night.
words.ex_cn: 他有失眠症，晚上睡不着。
words.en: If someone suffers from insomnia, they find it difficult to sleep.

words.tr: adj. 昏昏欲睡的；困倦的；催眠的
words.ex: The somnolent boy nodded off during class.
words.ex_cn: 那个昏昏欲睡的男孩在课堂上睡着了。
words.en: If you are somnolent, you feel sleepy.

words.tr: adj. 催眠的；使爱睡的；想睡的
words.ex: The professor's monotonous voice was somniferous, causing many students to doze off.
words.ex_cn: 教授单调的声音催眠，导致许多学生打瞌睡。
words.en: A somniferous substance or activity makes you feel sleepy or causes you to fall asleep.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SOPH

words.ex: The ancient Sophists were known for their teachings on rhetoric and philosophy.
words.ex_cn: 古希腊的诡辩家以其修辞学和哲学教导而闻名。
words.en: A sophist is a person who uses clever but false arguments, especially in order to deceive people.

words.ex: His argument was full of sophistry, making it difficult to discern the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点充满了诡辩，让人难以分辨真相。
words.en: Sophistry is the use of clever but false arguments, especially with the intention of deceiving.

words.tr:
n. 老于世故的人；见多识广的人
v. 使复杂；使变得世故
words.ex: He is a sophisticated who knows how to handle difficult people.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个老于世故的人，懂得如何应对难缠的人。
words.en: To make someone or something more knowledgeable, complex, or refined, especially through experience or education.

words.tr: adj. 二年级学生的；一知半解的；自信但幼稚浅薄的
words.ex: His sophomoric remarks showed a lack of depth in understanding.
words.ex_cn: 他一知半解的评论显示了他理解上的浅薄。
words.en: If you describe something as sophomoric, you mean that it is silly and immature, often in a way that is typical of a young person who is trying to be clever or funny.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SPEC/SPECT/SPIC

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.tr: n. 鬼怪；幽灵；缠绕心头的恐惧
words.ex: The specter of famine haunted the war-torn region.
words.ex_cn: 饥荒的幽灵在饱受战争蹂躏的地区徘徊。
words.en: A specter is a ghost or a phantom, or something that haunts or perturbs the mind.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.tr: adj. 回顾的；回想的；溯及既往的
words.ex: He made a retrospective look at his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他回顾了自己的童年。
words.en: A retrospective is an exhibition or compilation showing the development of an artist's work over a period of time. It can also refer to a look back at past events or situations.

words.tr: adj. 颖悟的；敏锐的；有洞察力的
words.ex: She is perspicacious and notices small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 她很敏锐，能注意到细小的错误。
words.en: Having a ready insight into and understanding of things.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SPIR

words.ex: Breathing deeply helps with respiration.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于呼吸。
words.en: The process of breathing, which involves inhaling oxygen and exhaling carbon dioxide.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.ex: He showed great spirit when he tried again after failing.
words.ex_cn: 他在失败后再次尝试时展现了极大的精神。
words.en: The part of a person that includes their mind, feelings, and character rather than their body.

words.tr: adj. 勇猛的； v. “spirit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The spirited dog chased the ball without fear.
words.ex_cn: 这只勇猛的狗毫不畏惧地追着球。
words.en: Someone who is spirited is full of energy, courage, and determination.

words.tr: n. 呼吸运动记录器，呼吸描记器
words.ex: The doctor used a spirograph to measure the patient's lung capacity.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用呼吸运动记录器来测量病人的肺活量。
words.en: A spirograph is a geometric drawing toy that produces mathematical curves of the variety technically known as hypotrochoids and epitrochoids.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes STAS/STAT

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: He wants to change the status quo.
words.ex_cn: 他想改变现状。
words.en: The status quo is the state of affairs that exists at a particular time, especially in contrast to a different possible state of affairs.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes STRICT/STRING

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: The school has stringent rules about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学校对作业有严格的规定。
words.en: Stringent measures, rules, or conditions are very strict or severe.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: The snake constricts its prey.
words.ex_cn: 蛇缠住它的猎物。
words.en: If something constricts you, it limits your actions so that you cannot do what you want to do.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes STRUCT

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.tr: adj. 不可摧毁的；破坏不了的
words.ex: The box is indestructible.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是不可摧毁的。
words.en: If something is indestructible, it is very strong and cannot be destroyed.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SUB-/SUC-/SUF-/SUG-/SUP-/SUS-

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: He used subterfuge to avoid answering the question.
words.ex_cn: 他用遁词来避免回答问题。
words.en: Deceit used in order to achieve one's goal.

words.ex: The rule subsumes all similar cases.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则涵盖所有类似的情况。
words.en: If something is subsumed within a larger group or class, it is included within it, rather than being considered as something separate.

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SUPER-/SUR-

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: The new law will supersede the old one.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将取代旧法律。
words.en: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

words.ex: The language barrier was insuperable for him.
words.ex_cn: 语言障碍对他来说是难以克服的。
words.en: If you describe a problem or obstacle as insuperable, you mean that it is impossible to overcome.

words.tr: adj. 高的；神的；天上的；超自然的
words.ex: The artist captured the supernal beauty of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家捕捉到了日落超凡脱俗的美。
words.en: Relating to the sky or the heavens; celestial. Also, of exceptional quality or extent.

words.tr: n. 附加税; vt. 对……征收附加税
words.ex: The government imposed a surtax on luxury goods.
words.ex_cn: 政府对奢侈品征收附加税。
words.en: An additional tax levied on something already taxed, especially on incomes above a certain level.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes SYL-/SYM-/SYN-/SYS-

words.tr: n. 三段论法；推论法；演绎
words.ex: He used a syllogism to prove his point.
words.ex_cn: 他用三段论来证明他的观点。
words.en: A syllogism is a form of reasoning in which a conclusion is drawn from two given or assumed propositions (premises); a common or middle term is present in the two premises but not in the conclusion, which is deduced from the premises.

words.tr: adj. 同时发生的；同步的；
words.ex: The two events happened synchronous.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生。
words.en: Happening or existing at the same time.

words.tr: n. 企业联合组织；财团
words.ex: The men formed a syndicate to buy the land.
words.ex_cn: 这些人组成了一个辛迪加来购买土地。
words.en: A syndicate is a group of individuals or organizations combined or making a joint effort to undertake some specific duty or carry out specific transactions or negotiations.

words.ex: The synthesis of ideas helped solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些想法的综合帮助解决了问题。
words.en: The act of combining different ideas, influences, or objects into a new and coherent whole.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TACT/TANG

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.tr: adj. 触觉的；能触知的；手感好的
words.ex: The child learns through tactile objects like blocks.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通过触觉物体如积木来学习。
words.en: Relating to the sense of touch; perceptible by touch.

words.ex: The sense of tactus is essential for the blind to navigate their environment.
words.ex_cn: 触觉对于盲人导航环境至关重要。
words.en: The sense of touch; contact.

words.tr: adj. 可触摸的；实际的；有形的；确凿的；
words.ex: The statue is tangible and can be touched.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像可以触摸，是实实在在的。
words.en: Something that is tangible is clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen, felt, or noticed.

words.ex: The line touches the circle at one point and is a tangent.
words.ex_cn: 这条线与圆在一个点相切，是一条切线。
words.en: A tangent is a straight line or plane that touches a curve or curved surface at a point, but if extended does not cross it at that point. In a more general sense, it can also refer to a sudden digression or change of course.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TELE-

words.tr:
n. 测距仪；遥测发射器
v. 遥测；用遥测发射器传送；遥测并传送数据
words.ex: The satellite uses a telemeter to send data to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星使用遥测仪向地球发送数据。
words.en: A telemeter is an instrument used for measuring distances, especially in surveying and in the military, by means of the time it takes for a signal to travel to a target and back.

words.tr: n. [自] 遥测技术；遥感勘测；自动测量记录传导
words.ex: The spacecraft's telemetry system provided real-time data on its position and speed.
words.ex_cn: 航天器的遥测系统提供了其实时位置和速度的数据。
words.en: Telemetry is the process of recording and transmitting the readings of an instrument.

words.ex: He works in telecommunication.
words.ex_cn: 他在电信行业工作。
words.en: Telecommunication is the technology of sending signals, images, and messages over long distances by telephone, radio, television, or satellite.

words.ex: The teleseism was detected by seismographs around the world.
words.ex_cn: 这次远震被世界各地的地震仪检测到。
words.en: A teleseism is an earthquake whose seismic waves are strong enough to be recorded by seismographs at great distances from the epicenter.

words.ex: Telephony has revolutionized the way we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 电话学已经彻底改变了我们的沟通方式。
words.en: Telephony is the technology and the methods used in the transmission of voice communications over distances, especially by means of wires or radio waves.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TEMPOR

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The temporal change of seasons affects our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 季节的时间变化影响我们的日常生活。
words.en: Relating to time as opposed to eternity; relating to worldly life as opposed to spiritual life.

words.tr: v. 敷衍；拖延；见风驶舵
words.ex: He decided to temporize until he had more information.
words.ex_cn: 他决定拖延时间，直到获得更多信息。
words.en: To temporize means to delay making a decision or giving a definite answer in order to gain time or avoid committing oneself.

words.tr: adj. 即席的；临时的；无准备的；不用讲稿的
words.ex: He gave an extemporaneous speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: spoken or done without preparation

words.ex: The project's temporality was a challenge for the team.
words.ex_cn: 项目的暂时性对团队来说是一个挑战。
words.en: The condition of being limited by time; the state of existing within or having some relationship with time.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TEN/TAIN

words.ex: The police will detain the suspect for questioning.
words.ex_cn: 警察将扣留嫌疑人进行审问。
words.en: If someone is detained, they are officially held in a place, especially a prison, and are not allowed to leave.

words.ex: This rule pertains to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If one thing pertains to another, it relates, belongs, or applies to it.

words.tr: adj. 紧握的；顽强的；坚决的；强的（记忆力）
words.ex: The child held the toy with tenacious hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用紧握的手抓住玩具。
words.en: If you describe someone as tenacious, you are admiring their determination to do something and their refusal to stop trying even when it is difficult.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: The teacher has a long tenure at the school.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师在学校有很长的任期。
words.en: The period during which an office is held; the status of holding one's position on a permanent basis.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TEND/TENS/TENT

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: There was a contention between the two students about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 两个学生对答案发生了争论。
words.en: A contention is a strong disagreement or argument about something. It can also refer to a point or statement that someone argues is true.

words.tr:
adj. 紧张的；拉紧的；
n. 时态；
words.ex: He felt tense before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张。
words.en: If you are tense, you are anxious and nervous and cannot relax.

words.tr: n. [数] 张量；[解剖] 张肌
words.ex: In differential geometry, a tensor is a generalization of the concept of vector.
words.ex_cn: 在微分几何中，张量是向量概念的推广。
words.en: A tensor is a mathematical entity analogous to but more general than a vector, represented by an array of components that are functions of the coordinates of a space.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TERM

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.tr:
adj. 期中的
n. 期中考试
words.ex: He is preparing for his midterm exam next week.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为下周的期中考试做准备。
words.en: A midterm is an examination that is given in the middle of a term in a school or college.

words.ex: The teacher will terminate the class at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下午5点结束课程。
words.en: To terminate something means to bring it to an end or to stop it from continuing.

words.ex: The meeting felt interminable.
words.ex_cn: 这场会议感觉没完没了。
words.en: If you describe something as interminable, you are emphasizing that it continues for a very long time and indicating that you find it boring or annoying.

words.tr: adj. 无条件的；无限期的
words.ex: The contract offered termless employment.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同提供了无限期的雇佣。
words.en: Without a fixed or specified limit in time; endless.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TERR

words.tr: adj. 水陆的；水陆两栖的
words.ex: The terraqueous globe is the Earth, which is covered by both land and water.
words.ex_cn: 水陆两栖的地球是覆盖着陆地和水的地球。
words.en: Consisting of or relating to both land and water.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.ex: The terrestrial animals live on land.
words.ex_cn: 陆地动物生活在陆地上。
words.en: Of, on, or relating to the earth.

words.tr: phrase. 坚实的陆地；（尤指与海洋或空中相对的）稳固地面
words.ex: After days at sea, the sailors were grateful to set foot on terra firma.
words.ex_cn: 在海上漂泊数天后，水手们很高兴能踏上坚实的地面。
words.en: Terra firma is used to refer to the solid earth as opposed to the sea or air.

words.tr: phrase. 未知领域；未被探索的土地（尤指地图上未标注的区域）
words.ex: The deep ocean remains a terra incognita for many scientists.
words.ex_cn: 深海对许多科学家来说仍然是一个未知领域。
words.en: An unknown or unexplored territory or field of knowledge.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes TERTI

words.tr: adj. 第三列的（指鸟飞羽中最后一列的）
words.ex: The tertial feathers of the bird are quite distinctive.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟的第三列羽毛非常独特。
words.en: Occurring in or relating to the third period or stage.

words.ex: Tertian fever is a type of recurring fever that occurs every other day.
words.ex_cn: 间日热是一种每隔一天就会复发的发热类型。
words.en: A type of fever that recurs every other day, characteristic of certain forms of malaria.

words.tr: adj. 第三的；高等教育的
words.ex: He works in the tertiary sector as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名教师在第三产业工作。
words.en: In the context of an economy, the tertiary sector is the part of the economy that provides services rather than producing goods. In geology, the Tertiary period is a former term for the period of time now called the Paleogene and Neogene periods, which followed the Cretaceous period.

words.tr: phrase. 第三种事物；介于两者之间的混合体（尤指无法归类于原有两类的事物）
words.ex: The tertium quid in the debate was often overlooked by the participants.
words.ex_cn: 辩论中的中间物常常被参与者忽略。
words.en: A third thing that is indefinite and undefined but related to two definite or known things.

words.tr: phrase. 三级颜色：在色彩理论中，由两个相邻的二级颜色混合而成的颜色，例如橙色、绿色和紫色。
words.ex: Purple is a tertiary color formed by mixing red and blue.
words.ex_cn: 紫色是由红色和蓝色混合而成的三级颜色。
words.en: A tertiary color is a color made by mixing either one primary color with one secondary color, or two secondary colors, in a given color space.

chapters.name: 300 High-Frequency Word Roots and Prefixes THE/THEI/THEO

words.ex: He is an atheist who does not believe in God.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名不信神的无神论者。
words.en: An atheist is a person who believes that there is no God or gods.

words.ex: The theocracy ruled with an iron fist.
words.ex_cn: 神权政体以铁腕统治。
